titleByLocale.it: Customer Ingegnere, Security, Google Cloud Sales (English)
titleByLocale.en: Customer Engineer, Security, Google Cloud Sales (English)
titleByLocale.de: Customer Ingenieur, Security, Google Cloud Sales (English)
titleByLocale.fr: Customer Ingénieur, Security, Google Cloud Sales (English)

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 6 years of experience in security or cloud native architectures in a customer-facing or technical sales engineering role.

• Experience in cybersecurity operations, specifically with SecOps (SIEM/SOAR) and in cybersecurity issues.

• Ability to communicate in English fluently, in order to speak publicly to geographically customers, and deliver technical presentations.

Preferred qualifications:

• Cloud or Security industry certifications.

• Advanced education in Computer Science, Engineering and Information Technology, or a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders (e.g., CISOs, CIOs).

• Presales and implementation experience with enterprise security solutions such as threat detection and hunting, malware intelligence, cloud security posture management, Artificial Intelligence (AI), architecture designs.

• Broad product and solution knowledge of market trends in the cybersecurity industry such as ransomware, attack frameworks, zero trust.

• Ability to communicate in German fluently, to allow for deeper engagement with German speaking customers.

About the job
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Security Customer Engineer and SecOps specialist covering enterprises in the EMEA North market (Nordics, CEE, DACH), you will help us grow our cybersecurity business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €112000 - €114000 (EUR) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Work with Google Cloud Security products to demonstrate and prototype advanced integrations within complex customer and partner environments.

• Architect and recommend comprehensive integration strategies, enterprise architectures, and AI-ready infrastructures required to successfully implement holistic Google Cloud Security solutions.

• Act as a prominent public advocate and thought leader for Google Cloud Security at customer sites, industry conferences, and events, articulating Google's goal for security in the age of AI.

• Understand complex customer technical objections and develop, AI-driven solutions to resolve blockers for enterprise accounts.

• Advocate our dual mission of "AI for Security" and "Security for AI." Share deep security expertise to build strong technical relationships, leading technology advocacy, bid responses, and proof-of-concepts, while partnering with product management to shape the future of Google Cloud Security solutions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 6 anni di esperienza nelle architetture di sicurezza o cloud nativo in un ruolo di ingegneria delle vendite di clienti o tecnico.

• Esperienza nelle operazioni di sicurezza informatica, in particolare con SecOps (SIEM/SOAR) e in problemi di sicurezza informatica.

• Capacità di comunicare in inglese fluentemente, per parlare pubblicamente ai clienti geografici, e fornire presentazioni tecniche.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Certificazioni del settore Cloud o Security.

• Istruzione avanzata in Informatica, ingegneria e tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo tecnico, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• Esperienza nell'impegnarsi e presentarsi a stakeholder tecnici e dirigenti (ad esempio, CISOs, CIO).

• Esperienza di prevendita e implementazione con soluzioni di sicurezza aziendale come il rilevamento delle minacce e la caccia, l'intelligenza malware, la gestione della postura della sicurezza cloud, l'intelligenza artificiale (AI), i progetti di architettura.

• Ampia conoscenza del prodotto e della soluzione delle tendenze del mercato nel settore della sicurezza informatica come ransomware, quadri di attacco, zero fiducia.

• Capacità di comunicare in tedesco fluentemente, per consentire un più profondo impegno con i clienti di lingua tedesca.

Riguardo al lavoro
Quando le aziende leader scelgono Google Cloud, è una grande vittoria per diffondere la potenza del cloud computing a livello globale. Una volta che istituzioni educative, agenzie governative e altre aziende si firmano per utilizzare i prodotti Google Cloud, si entra per facilitare il loro lavoro più produttivo, mobile e collaborativo. Ascolti e consegna ciò che è più utile per il cliente. Assisti i colleghi di vendita Googlers risolvendo problemi tecnici chiave per i nostri clienti. Si accoppia con la gestione del marketing del prodotto e team di ingegneria per rimanere in cima alle tendenze del settore e elaborare miglioramenti ai prodotti Google Cloud.

In qualità di ingegnere del cliente di sicurezza e specialista SecOps che copre le imprese nel mercato EMEA North (Nordics, CEE, DACH), ci aiuterà a crescere il nostro business della sicurezza informatica costruendo e espandendo i rapporti con i clienti nuovi e esistenti. Google Cloud accelera la capacità di ogni organizzazione di trasformare digitalmente il suo business e l'industria. Offriamo soluzioni di livello enterprise che sfruttano la tecnologia all'avanguardia di Google e gli strumenti che aiutano gli sviluppatori a costruire in modo più sostenibile. I clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori si rivolgono a Google Cloud come partner affidabile per consentire la crescita e risolvere i loro problemi aziendali più critici. La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti.

Germania: € 112000 - €114000 (EUR) + 42,86% target bonus + equità + prestazioni

Ulteriori informazioni sui benefici a Google .
responsabilità

• Lavorare con i prodotti Google Cloud Security per dimostrare e prototipo di integrazioni avanzate all'interno di ambienti di clienti e partner complessi.

• Architetto e consiglia strategie di integrazione complete, architetture aziendali e infrastrutture AI-ready necessarie per implementare con successo soluzioni di Google Cloud Security.

• Agire come un importante sostenitore pubblico e leader di pensiero per Google Cloud Security presso i siti dei clienti, conferenze del settore e eventi, articolando l'obiettivo di Google per la sicurezza nell'era dell'AI.

• Comprendere complesse obiezioni tecniche dei clienti e sviluppare, soluzioni basate su AI per risolvere i bloccanti per i conti aziendali.

• Avvocato la nostra duplice missione di "AI per la Sicurezza" e "Sicurezza per l'AI". Condividi competenze di sicurezza profonde per costruire relazioni tecniche forti, advocacy della tecnologia leader, risposte di offerta e prove-di-concetti, mentre collabora con la gestione dei prodotti per modellare il futuro delle soluzioni di Google Cloud Security.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 6 Jahre Erfahrung in Sicherheits- oder Cloud-nativen Architekturen in einer kundenorientierten oder technischen Vertriebstechnik.

• Erfahrung in Cybersicherheitsoperationen, insbesondere mit SecOps (SIEM / SOAR) und in Cybersicherheitsfragen.

• Fähigkeit, fließend auf Englisch zu kommunizieren, um öffentlich mit geographischen Kunden zu sprechen und technische Präsentationen zu liefern.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Cloud- oder Security-Zertifizierungen.

• Fortgeschrittene Ausbildung in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen und Informationstechnologie oder einem technischen Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit und der Präsentation von technischen Stakeholdern und Führungskräften (z. B. CISOs, CIOs).

• Presales und Implementierungserfahrung mit Unternehmenssicherheitslösungen wie Bedrohungserkennung und -jagd, Malware Intelligence, Cloud Security Posture Management, Künstliche Intelligenz (KI), Architekturdesigns.

• Breites Produkt- und Lösungswissen über Markttrends in der Cybersicherheitsbranche wie Ransomware, Angriffsframeworks, Zero Trust.

• Fähigkeit, fließend auf Deutsch zu kommunizieren, um eine tiefere Interaktion mit deutschsprachigen Kunden zu ermöglichen.

Über den Job
Wenn sich führende Unternehmen für Google Cloud entscheiden, ist dies ein großer Gewinn für die weltweite Verbreitung der Leistungsfähigkeit von Cloud Computing. Sobald sich Bildungseinrichtungen, Regierungsbehörden und andere Unternehmen für die Nutzung von Google Cloud-Produkten anmelden, können Sie ihre Arbeit produktiver, mobiler und kooperativer gestalten. Sie hören zu und liefern, was für den Kunden am hilfreichsten ist. Sie unterstützen Mitverkäufer bei der Problemlösung wichtiger technischer Probleme für unsere Kunden. Sie arbeiten mit den Teams für Produktmarketingmanagement und Engineering zusammen, um auf dem Laufenden zu bleiben und Verbesserungen für Google Cloud-Produkte zu entwickeln.

Als Security Customer Engineer und SecOps-Spezialist für Unternehmen im EMEA North-Markt (Nordics, CEE, DACH) helfen Sie uns, unser Cybersicherheitsgeschäft auszubauen, indem Sie Beziehungen zu neuen und bestehenden Kunden aufbauen und ausbauen. Google Cloud beschleunigt die Fähigkeit jedes Unternehmens, sein Geschäft und seine Branche digital zu verändern. Wir liefern Lösungen für Unternehmen, die die modernste Technologie von Google nutzen, und Tools, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre wichtigsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen. Die individuelle Bezahlung wird durch Faktoren wie berufsbezogene Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und relevante Aus- oder Weiterbildung bestimmt.

Deutschland: €112000 - €114000 (EUR) + 42,86% Bonusziel + Eigenkapital + Leistungen

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Vorteile bei Google.
Zuständigkeiten

• Arbeiten Sie mit Google Cloud Security-Produkten, um fortschrittliche Integrationen in komplexen Kunden- und Partnerumgebungen zu demonstrieren und zu prototypisieren.

• Erstellen und empfehlen Sie umfassende Integrationsstrategien, Unternehmensarchitekturen und AI-fähige Infrastrukturen, die für die erfolgreiche Implementierung ganzheitlicher Google Cloud Security-Lösungen erforderlich sind.

• Handeln Sie als prominenter öffentlicher Fürsprecher und Vordenker für Google Cloud Security bei Kundenstandorten, Branchenkonferenzen und Veranstaltungen und artikulieren Sie Googles Ziel für Sicherheit im Zeitalter der KI.

• Verstehen Sie komplexe technische Einwände von Kunden und entwickeln Sie KI-gesteuerte Lösungen, um Blocker für Unternehmenskonten zu lösen.

• Befürworten Sie unsere doppelte Mission von "AI for Security" und "Security for AI". Teilen Sie umfassendes Sicherheits-Know-how, um starke technische Beziehungen aufzubauen, Technologie-Advocacy, Angebotsantworten und Proof-of-Concepts zu führen und gleichzeitig mit dem Produktmanagement die Zukunft der Google Cloud Security-Lösungen zu gestalten.

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 6 ans d'expérience dans les architectures natives de sécurité ou de cloud dans un rôle d'ingénierie de vente orienté vers le client ou technique.

• Expérience des opérations de cybersécurité, en particulier avec SecOps (SIEM/SOAR) et des questions de cybersécurité.

• Capacité de communiquer couramment en anglais, afin de parler publiquement aux clients géographiques et de présenter des présentations techniques.

Titres préférés:

• Certifications Cloud ou Sécurité.

• Enseignement supérieur en informatique, en génie et en technologie de l'information, ou dans un domaine technique, ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• Expérience de la collaboration et de la présentation avec les intervenants techniques et les dirigeants exécutifs (p. ex., les OSC, les OIC).

• Préventes et expérience de mise en œuvre avec des solutions de sécurité d'entreprise telles que la détection de menaces et la chasse, l'intelligence des logiciels malveillants, la gestion des postures de sécurité du cloud, l'intelligence artificielle (AI), les conceptions d'architecture.

• Grande connaissance des produits et des solutions des tendances du marché dans l'industrie de la cybersécurité comme les ransomwares, les cadres d'attaque, la confiance zéro.

• Capacité de communiquer en allemand couramment, pour permettre un engagement plus profond avec les clients germanophones.

Sur le travail
Lorsque les grandes entreprises choisissent Google Cloud, c'est une énorme victoire pour diffuser la puissance du cloud computing au niveau mondial. Une fois que les établissements d'enseignement, les agences gouvernementales et d'autres entreprises s'engagent à utiliser les produits Google Cloud, vous venez pour faciliter leur travail plus productif, mobile et collaboratif. Vous écoutez et livrez ce qui est le plus utile pour le client. Vous aidez les autres ventes Googlers en résolvant les problèmes techniques clés pour nos clients. Vous êtes en contact avec les équipes de marketing et d'ingénierie de produits pour rester au-dessus des tendances de l'industrie et concevoir des améliorations aux produits Google Cloud.

En tant qu'ingénieur client de sécurité et spécialiste SecOps couvrant les entreprises du marché Nord de l'EMEA (Nordics, CEE, DACH), vous nous aiderez à développer notre activité de cybersécurité en établissant et en développant des relations avec des clients nouveaux et existants. Google Cloud accélère la capacité de chaque organisation à transformer numériquement ses activités et son industrie. Nous fournissons des solutions de qualité entreprise qui tirent parti de la technologie de pointe de Google, et des outils qui aident les développeurs à construire plus durablement. Les clients de plus de 200 pays et territoires se tournent vers Google Cloud en tant que partenaire de confiance pour favoriser la croissance et résoudre leurs problèmes commerciaux les plus critiques. La rémunération individuelle est déterminée par des facteurs tels que les compétences professionnelles, l'expérience et les études ou la formation pertinentes.

Allemagne: 112000 € - 114000 € (EUR) + 42,86 % de bonus

En savoir plus sur les avantages chez Google .
Responsabilités

• Travailler avec les produits Google Cloud Security pour démontrer et prototyper des intégrations avancées dans des environnements clients et partenaires complexes.

• Architecte et recommande des stratégies d'intégration complètes, des architectures d'entreprise et des infrastructures prêtes à l'IA nécessaires pour mettre en œuvre avec succès des solutions globales de sécurité Google Cloud.

• Agir en tant que défenseur public et leader de la pensée pour Google Cloud Security sur les sites clients, les conférences de l'industrie et les événements, en articulant l'objectif de Google pour la sécurité à l'ère de l'IA.

• Comprendre les objections techniques complexes des clients et développer des solutions basées sur l'IA pour résoudre les bloqueurs pour les comptes d'entreprise.

• Adoptez notre double mission « AI pour la sécurité » et « Sécurité pour AI ». Partager une expertise en matière de sécurité profonde pour établir de solides relations techniques, des activités de promotion de la technologie, des réponses aux soumissions et des preuves de concepts, tout en s'associant à la gestion des produits pour façonner l'avenir des solutions Google Cloud Security.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Exploits, Google Threat Intelligence Group

titleByLocale.it: Senior Security Ingegnere, Exploits, Google Threat Intelligence Group
titleByLocale.en: Senior Security Engineer, Exploits, Google Threat Intelligence Group
titleByLocale.de: Senior Security Ingenieur, Exploits, Google Threat Intelligence Group
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Security Ingénieur, Exploits, Google Threat Intelligence Group

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience in threat intelligence, intrusion analysis, vulnerability researcher, or a similar security role.

• Experience with threat intelligence platforms and tools (e.g., VirusTotal, SIEMs).

Preferred qualifications:

• Knowledge of Android and Chrome security and internals.

• Deep understanding of attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs).

• Proven ability to lead complex threat research projects independently.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Skills in malware analysis, reverse engineering, or vulnerability analysis.

• Proficiency in scripting or querying languages (e.g., Python, GoogleSQL).

About the job
 Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

Join the Google Threat Intelligence Group's (GTIG) Exploits Mission. The Exploits Mission focuses on protecting users from targeted exploitation, primarily from government-backed attackers and Commercial Surveillance Vendors (CSVs), through the detection, analysis, and ultimate prevention of vulnerabilities and exploits, with a special focus on 0-day attacks.
 We provide timely, actionable intelligence and coordinate with internal and external partners to fix critical vulnerabilities and secure user devices.
 As a Security Engineer on our team, you will conduct in-depth research on threat groups, their Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and the malware they employ. You'll utilize Google's powerful internal intelligence platforms, Nirvana and mGraph, to model threat activity and generate actionable insights. This role involves close collaboration with various teams across GTIG and Google to develop and implement effective countermeasures, contributing directly to threat disruption and enhancing our collective security posture. We are looking for engineers passionate about threat research who can lead projects and mentor others.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €128000 - €131000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Create and deploy detection signatures (autoqueries, Watchtower rules) to maintain visibility over threat actors and assist in closing security gaps.

• Produce polished, high-quality technical intelligence documentation and actor profiles to deliver actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders.

• Influence technical direction within your scope, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with cross-functional Google teams to support threat disruption efforts. Collaborate with security engineers and product teams in designing innovative exploit mitigations.

• Identify and execute opportunities for continuous improvement: analytic collection, process optimization, and automation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Laurea in Informatica, Cybersecurity, un campo correlato, o equivalente esperienza pratica.

• 5 anni di esperienza in intelligenza delle minacce, analisi delle intrusioni, ricercatore di vulnerabilità, o un ruolo di sicurezza simile.

• Esperienza con piattaforme e strumenti di intelligenza della minaccia (ad esempio, VirusTotal, SIEMs).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Conoscenza di sicurezza e interni Android e Chrome.

• Profonda comprensione dell'attaccante Tattica, Tecniche e Procedure (TTP).

• Prove capacità di condurre progetti di ricerca di minacce complessi indipendentemente.

• Forte capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di comunicazione.

• Competenze in analisi malware, reverse engineering o analisi delle vulnerabilità.

• Proficienza nelle lingue di scrittura o querying (ad esempio, Python, GoogleSQL).

Riguardo al lavoro
Il nostro team di sicurezza lavora per creare e mantenere l'ambiente operativo più sicuro per gli utenti e gli sviluppatori di Google. Gli ingegneri di sicurezza lavorano con apparecchiature di rete e monitorano attivamente i nostri sistemi per attacchi e intrusioni. In questo ruolo, lavorerai anche con gli ingegneri del software per identificare proattivamente e correggere i difetti di sicurezza e le vulnerabilità.

Partecipa alla missione di Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) Exploits. La missione Exploits si concentra sulla protezione degli utenti da sfruttamento mirato, principalmente da attaccanti di governo e venditori di sorveglianza commerciale (CSV), attraverso la rilevazione, l'analisi e la prevenzione finale di vulnerabilità e exploit, con una particolare attenzione agli attacchi di 0 giorni.
Forniamo intelligenza tempestiva, attivabile e coordinate con partner interni ed esterni per risolvere vulnerabilità critiche e dispositivi utente sicuri.
In qualità di Ingegnere di Sicurezza del nostro team, condurrete una ricerca approfondita sui gruppi di minacce, i loro Tattici, Tecniche e Procedure (TTP), e il malware che utilizzano. Userete le potenti piattaforme di intelligenza interna di Google, Nirvana e mGraph, per modellare l'attività di minaccia e generare intuizioni attuabili. Questo ruolo coinvolge una stretta collaborazione con vari team di GTIG e Google per sviluppare e implementare efficaci contromisure, contribuendo direttamente alla minaccia di interruzione e migliorare la nostra postura di sicurezza collettiva. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri appassionati di ricerca di minacce che possono guidare progetti e mentore altri.

responsabilità

• Analisi tecniche complesse di piombo, attività di modellazione delle minacce, TTP e Indicatori di Compromise (IOC) su piattaforme interne (mGraph, Nirvana).

• Creare e distribuire le firme di rilevamento (autoquerie, regole Watchtower) per mantenere la visibilità sugli attori delle minacce e aiutare a chiudere le lacune di sicurezza.

• Produci documentazione tecnica di intelligenza lucida e di alta qualità e profili attori per fornire informazioni attuabili agli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Influenza la direzione tecnica all'interno del vostro ambito, mentore ingegneri junior, e collaborare con i team di Google interfunzionali per sostenere gli sforzi di interruzione della minaccia. Collabora con ingegneri di sicurezza e team di prodotti nella progettazione di mitigazioni innovative di exploit.

• Identificare ed eseguire opportunità di miglioramento continuo: raccolta analitica, ottimizzazione dei processi e automazione.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Kenntnisse der Android- und Chrome-Sicherheit und Interna.

• Tiefes Verständnis der Angreifer Taktik, Techniken und Verfahren (TTPs).

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe Bedrohungsforschungsprojekte unabhängig zu leiten.

• Starke analytische, Problemlösungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeiten in Malware-Analyse, Reverse Engineering oder Schwachstellenanalyse.

• Kenntnisse in Skripting oder Abfrage von Sprachen (z. B. Python, GoogleSQL).

Über den Job
Unser Sicherheitsteam arbeitet daran, die sicherste Betriebsumgebung für Benutzer und Entwickler von Google zu schaffen und zu pflegen. Security Engineers arbeiten mit Netzwerkausrüstung und überwachen unsere Systeme aktiv auf Angriffe und Eindringlinge. In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie auch mit Software-Ingenieuren zusammen, um Sicherheitslücken und Schwachstellen proaktiv zu identifizieren und zu beheben.

Treten Sie der Exploits Mission der Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) bei. Die Exploits-Mission konzentriert sich auf den Schutz der Benutzer vor gezielter Ausbeutung, vor allem vor staatlich unterstützten Angreifern und CSVs (Commercial Surveillance Vendors), durch die Erkennung, Analyse und ultimative Prävention von Schwachstellen und Exploits, wobei ein besonderer Schwerpunkt auf 0-Tage-Angriffen liegt.
Wir bieten zeitnahe, umsetzbare Informationen und stimmen uns mit internen und externen Partnern ab, um kritische Schwachstellen zu beheben und Benutzergeräte zu sichern.
Als Security Engineer in unserem Team werden Sie eingehende Untersuchungen zu Bedrohungsgruppen, ihren Taktiken, Techniken und Verfahren (TTPs) und der von ihnen verwendeten Malware durchführen. Sie nutzen die leistungsstarken internen Intelligenzplattformen von Google, Nirvana und mGraph, um Bedrohungsaktivitäten zu modellieren und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu generieren. Diese Rolle beinhaltet eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams in GTIG und Google, um wirksame Gegenmaßnahmen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, die direkt zu Bedrohungsstörungen beitragen und unsere kollektive Sicherheitslage verbessern. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die sich für Bedrohungsforschung begeistern und Projekte leiten und andere betreuen können.

Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie komplexe technische Analysen, Modellierung von Bedrohungsaktivitäten, TTPs und Indikatoren für Kompromisse (IOCs) auf internen Plattformen (mGraph, Nirvana).

• Erstellen und Bereitstellen von Erkennungssignaturen (Autos, Wachtturm-Regeln), um die Sichtbarkeit über Bedrohungsakteure zu gewährleisten und dabei zu helfen, Sicherheitslücken zu schließen.

• Erstellen Sie eine polierte, qualitativ hochwertige Dokumentation der technischen Intelligenz und Akteursprofile, um internen und externen Stakeholdern umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu liefern.

• Beeinflussen Sie die technische Ausrichtung in Ihrem Bereich, beraten Sie Junior-Ingenieure und arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Google-Teams zusammen, um die Bemühungen um Bedrohungsstörungen zu unterstützen. Arbeiten Sie mit Sicherheitsingenieuren und Produktteams bei der Entwicklung innovativer Exploit-Abwehrmaßnahmen zusammen.

• Identifizieren und Ausführen von Möglichkeiten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung: Analysesammlung, Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung.

Notre équipe de sécurité travaille à créer et maintenir l'environnement d'exploitation le plus sûr pour les utilisateurs et les développeurs de Google. jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in C++ or Python programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Deep understanding of machine learning principles to ensure algorithms perform within strict power limits.

• Maintaining a current and thorough understanding of the latest developments in Digital Signal Processors (DSP), Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP), and system-on-chip (SoC) architectures to effectively leverage hardware-specific features for maximum efficiency and thermal management.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will conduct rigorous power profiling and implement hardware-specific optimizations to ensure feature performance remains consistent across all use cases. You will work at the intersection of ML and system architecture, technical specialists will define the efficiency standards on next-generation hardware. You will optimize the end-to-end performance of ML models to ensure compliance with strict power and thermal constraints, as the scope of the role encompasses leveraging specialized expertise in Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) and Digital Signal Processors (DSP) architectures to accelerate machine learning models while maintaining system stability and device performance standards.The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first-party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.
 Responsibilities

• Utilise Digital Signal Processors (DSP) and Hexagon Tensor Processors (HTP) architectures to accelerate ML models while effectively minimizing thermal impact.

• Conduct rigorous power profiling and implement hardware-specific optimizations to maintain consistent feature performance across all use cases.

• Own the end-to-end performance optimization of models to operate within a strict power budget.

• Define the efficiency standards on next-generation hardware at the intersection of ML and system architecture.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Ottimizzare le prestazioni end-to-end dei modelli ML per garantire il rispetto di rigidi vincoli di potenza e termici, in quanto il campo di applicazione del ruolo comprende sfruttando competenze specialistiche in Exagon Tensor Processors (HTP) e Digital Signal Processors (DSP) architetture per accelerare i modelli di machine learning pur mantenendo standard di stabilità del sistema e prestazioni del dispositivo. Il team di Piattaforme e Dispositivi comprende le varie piattaforme software di elaborazione di Google in ambienti (desktop, mobile, applicazioni), così come i nostri dispositivi e servizi di prima parte che combinano il meglio di Google AI, software e hardware. Squadre in questa area di ricerca, progettazione e sviluppo di nuove tecnologie per rendere l'interazione del nostro utente con l'informatica più veloce e senza soluzione di continuità, costruendo esperienze innovative per i nostri utenti in tutto il mondo.

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Graduate of the highest level of secondary school.

• Academic grades in the average of 4.5 or higher.

• Completed Multicheck (Wirtschaft and Administration).

• Ability to communicate in English and German fluently, to interact with stakeholders and schools.

Preferred qualifications:

• Strong problem solving and interconnected thinking skills.

• Excellent organizational talent with great presentation and teamwork skills.

• Interest in data and awareness of digital trends.

• Enthusiasm and passion for new technologies and tools, demonstrated through personal projects and interest in learning new skills.

• Intention to pursue the Berufsmaturitätsschule (BM1) during the apprenticeship.

• Have authorization to work in Switzerland.

About the job
 A professional team of vocational trainers (Berufsbildner:innen) will guide and support you during your 4-year apprenticeship with Google. After a 1-year foundation course (Basislehrjahr) you will join your Google team in Zurich and will be fully engaged in existing and new projects that will challenge you and lay the foundation for a successful future as a Digital Business Developer.
 Embedded in our business teams, you will focus on structuring and developing improved digital processes and models. You will analyze, interpret, and visualize data to enhance understanding. You will also communicate your findings and ideas effectively to others. You will rotate through various teams, each with different specializations, to gain a comprehensive understanding of the different roles in this rapidly evolving field.

Responsibilities

• Analyze current processes to develop optimization proposals.

• Support the implementation of digital solutions by creating training materials and user documentation.

• Analyze data and interpret results.

• Develop high quality visualizations and presentations for your target audience.

• Collaborate in projects, coordinate workflows, and engage with internal subject matter experts.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

• 1 year of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 1 year of experience implementing core ML concepts.

Preferred qualifications:

• 1 year of experience developing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems.

• 1 year of experience with software development in C++.

• 1 year of experience with machine learning concepts, especially on the training side.

• 1 year of experience with data processing (data structures, databases, streaming or batch processing tech such as Kafka, Apache Beam or Cloud Dataflow).

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The YouTube Foundational Data team is the heartbeat of YouTube. We translate enormous amounts of raw global user activity (billions of signals per minute) into critical, semantically meaningful quantities that power the YouTube experience. We make the viewcount numbers go up on video watch pages, provide a wide variety of stats for creators, internal analytics, trust and safety, and we deliver the training data that powers the ML behind personalized video recommendations.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
 Responsibilities

• Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

• Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

• Write product or system development code; Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

• Contribute to key initiatives in alignment with our OKRs via coding, analysis, monitoring/alerting work, scoping, design and other engineering work; Contribute to maintaining our systems via onduty/oncall rotation membership and addressing incremental issues.

• Interact with our network of clients and partner teams to ensure a successful delivery of the work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 1 anno di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio, Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

• 1 anno di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• 1 anno di esperienza nell'attuazione dei concetti di base ML.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• 1 anno di esperienza nello sviluppo di infrastrutture su larga scala o sistemi distribuiti.

• 1 anno di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in C++.

• 1 anno di esperienza con i concetti di machine learning, soprattutto sul lato della formazione.

• 1 anno di esperienza con l'elaborazione dei dati (strutture dati, database, streaming o tecnologia di elaborazione batch come Kafka, Apache Beam o Cloud Dataflow).

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Il team di YouTube Foundational Data è il cuore di YouTube. Traduciamo enormi quantità di attività utente globale raw (milioni di segnali al minuto) in quantità critiche e semanticamente significative che alimentano l'esperienza di YouTube. Facciamo salire i numeri del viewcount sulle pagine dell'orologio video, fornire una vasta gamma di statistiche per i creatori, analisi interna, fiducia e sicurezza, e forniamo i dati di formazione che alimenta il ML dietro raccomandazioni video personalizzate.
Su YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo è un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo la comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo comune per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e divertiamo — e lo facciamo tutti insieme.

• 1 year of experience with machine learning concepts, especially on the training side.

• 1 year of experience with data processing (data structures, databases, streaming or batch processing tech such as Kafka, Apache Beam or Cloud Dataflow).

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The YouTube Foundational Data team is the heartbeat of YouTube. We translate enormous amounts of raw global user activity (billions of signals per minute) into critical, semantically meaningful quantities that power the YouTube experience. We make the viewcount numbers go up on video watch pages, provide a wide variety of stats for creators, internal analytics, trust and safety, and we deliver the training data that powers the ML behind personalized video recommendations.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

• Contribute to key initiatives in alignment with our OKRs via coding, analysis, monitoring/alerting work, scoping, design and other engineering work; Contribute to maintaining our systems via onduty/oncall rotation membership and addressing incremental issues.

• Interact with our network of clients and partner teams to ensure a successful delivery of the work.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 6 years of experience in product design or UX.

• Include a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in product design or UX.

• Ability to operate in a fluid, iterative, and startup like environment, maintaining the flexibility to pivot design strategies based on user feedback or technical feasibility.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and leadership skills, with an ability to translate high level strategic briefs into design directions.

• Excellent visual design and prototyping skills, with the ability to create clean, polished layouts using and extending existing design libraries.

About the job
 At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy-to-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, leveraging user insights to create industry-leading products.

As an Interaction Designer, you'll apply user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences from concept to execution, working with design partners to evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative products.

User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”
 Responsibilities

• Influence stakeholders across functions to gain support for design strategies.

• Drive the development of innovative design solutions to user, product, and business problems.

• Drive a holistic design process, design system, or design language across teams or products.

• Drive design solutions based on user insights, business needs, and industry trends that further business outcomes.

• Provide direction to UX designers in creating design concepts for product ideation or user research/testing.

• Eccellente design visivo e capacità di prototipazione, con la capacità di creare layout puliti e lucidi utilizzando e ampliando le librerie di design esistenti.

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google, "Focus sull'utente e tutto il resto seguirà". I nostri progettisti di interazione trasformano compiti complessi in esperienze intuitive e facili da usare per miliardi di persone. Dalla creazione di flussi utente e wireframe per la costruzione di mockup e prototipi, si prevede e portare a vita esperienze di prodotto con un'atmosfera ispirata, raffinata e magica. Ti unirai al nostro team UX multidisciplinare, collaborando con Engineering e Product Management, sfruttando le informazioni degli utenti per creare prodotti leader nel settore.

In qualità di Interaction Designer, applicherai metodi di progettazione orientati all'utente per creare esperienze utente leader del settore dal concetto all'esecuzione, lavorando con partner di design per evolvere il linguaggio di design di Google per costruire prodotti belli e innovativi.

L'esperienza dell'utente è all'avanguardia nel modo in cui creiamo prodotti intuitivi, innovativi e belli che la gente ama. Ci sforziamo di imparare e comprendere le esigenze, i comportamenti e le emozioni dei nostri utenti per raccogliere informazioni che informano la strategia e il design del prodotto. I nostri team UX includono designer, ricercatori, strateghi dei contenuti e ingegneri che sono appassionati di qualità, usabilità e semplicità. Lavoriamo su team collaborativi per risolvere complesse sfide e esperienze artigianali che evidenziano le capacità e le personalità uniche dei nostri prodotti. Il nostro lavoro tocca miliardi esemplifica un principio chiave che è fondamentale per la filosofia di Google: “Focus sull’utente e tutto il resto seguirà”.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Research and Gemini

titleByLocale.it: Senior Software Ingegnere, Operations Ricerca and Gemini
titleByLocale.en: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Research and Gemini
titleByLocale.de: Senior Software Ingenieur, Operations Forschung and Gemini
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Software Ingénieur, Operations Recherche and Gemini

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience with software development in Python.

• 3 years of experience building training and evaluation datasets for Generative AI models.

• 3 years of experience operating within the core technology stack of modern Large Language Models (LLMs).

• 3 years of experience in machine learning research or machine learning infrastructure.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

• Experience in combinatorial optimization or other areas of operations research.

• Experience in reinforcement learning.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Operations Research group builds technology to solve optimization problems for the world, Alphabet, and Google. You will join a team that works at the intersection of Operations Research and Gemini, primarily focused on using optimization techniques to improve Gemini. You will either already have a working knowledge of optimization techniques.
 Google Research addresses challenges that define the technology of today and tomorrow. From conducting fundamental research to influencing product development, our research teams have the opportunity to impact technology used by billions of people every day.

Our teams aspire to make discoveries that impact everyone, and core to our approach is sharing our research and tools to fuel progress in the field -- we publish regularly in academic journals, release projects as open source, and apply research to Google products.

Responsibilities

• Build evaluation datasets, autoraters, and reward functions to assess and improve Gemini capabilities.

• Develop user simulators to test and refine model interactions.

• Construct agentic harnesses that enable models to interface with optimization solvers.

• Partner with product areas to integrate optimization solvers into their Generative AI offerings.

• Identify model capability gaps and devise concrete technical solutions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in Python.

• 3 anni di esperienza di formazione ed elaborazione dati di valutazione per modelli AI Generativi.

• 3 anni di esperienza che operano all'interno dello stack di tecnologia di base dei moderni modelli di lingua grande (LLMs).

• 3 anni di esperienza nella ricerca di machine learning o nell'infrastruttura di machine learning.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.

• 5 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• 3 anni di esperienza che lavorano in un complesso, matrice organizzazione che coinvolge progetti interfunzionali o cross-business.

• Esperienza nell'ottimizzazione combinatoria o in altri settori della ricerca operativa.

• Esperienza nell'apprendimento del rinforzo.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Il gruppo Operations Research costruisce la tecnologia per risolvere i problemi di ottimizzazione per il mondo, Alphabet e Google. Ti unirai a un team che lavora all'incrocio tra Operations Research e Gemini, focalizzato principalmente sull'utilizzo di tecniche di ottimizzazione per migliorare Gemini. Si avrà già una conoscenza di lavoro di tecniche di ottimizzazione.
Google Research affronta le sfide che definiscono la tecnologia di oggi e di domani. Dal condurre una ricerca fondamentale per influenzare lo sviluppo del prodotto, i nostri team di ricerca hanno l'opportunità di influenzare la tecnologia utilizzata da miliardi di persone ogni giorno.

I nostri team aspirano a fare scoperte che colpiscono tutti, e core al nostro approccio sta condividendo la nostra ricerca e strumenti per alimentare il progresso nel campo -- pubblichiamo regolarmente in riviste accademiche, rilasciano progetti come open source, e applichiamo la ricerca ai prodotti di Google.

responsabilità

• Costruire set di dati di valutazione, autoraters e funzioni di ricompensa per valutare e migliorare le capacità Gemini.

• Sviluppa simulatori utente per testare e perfezionare le interazioni dei modelli.

• Costruire imbracature agentiche che permettono ai modelli di interfacciarsi con i risolutori di ottimizzazione.

• Partner con aree di prodotto per integrare i risolutori di ottimizzazione nelle loro offerte AI Generative.

• Identificare le lacune di capacità del modello e ideare soluzioni tecniche concrete.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in Python.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung beim Aufbau von Trainings- und Evaluierungsdatensätzen für generische KI-Modelle.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Kerntechnologie-Stack moderner Large Language Models (LLMs).

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der maschinellen Lernforschung oder der Infrastruktur für maschinelles Lernen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer komplexen, matrixförmigen Organisation mit funktionsübergreifenden oder geschäftsübergreifenden Projekten.

• Erfahrung in kombinatorischer Optimierung oder anderen Bereichen der Operationsforschung.

• Erfahrung im Reinforcement Learning.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Die Operations Research-Gruppe entwickelt Technologie, um Optimierungsprobleme für die Welt, Alphabet und Google zu lösen. Sie werden einem Team beitreten, das an der Schnittstelle von Operations Research und Gemini arbeitet und sich hauptsächlich auf die Verwendung von Optimierungstechniken zur Verbesserung von Gemini konzentriert. Sie haben entweder bereits Kenntnisse in Optimierungstechniken.
Google Research adressiert Herausforderungen, die die Technologie von heute und morgen definieren. Von der Grundlagenforschung bis hin zur Beeinflussung der Produktentwicklung haben unsere Forschungsteams die Möglichkeit, die Technologie zu beeinflussen, die täglich von Milliarden von Menschen genutzt wird.

Unsere Teams streben nach Entdeckungen, die alle betreffen, und der Kern unseres Ansatzes ist es, unsere Forschung und Werkzeuge zu teilen, um Fortschritte in diesem Bereich zu erzielen - wir veröffentlichen regelmäßig in akademischen Zeitschriften, veröffentlichen Projekte als Open Source und wenden Forschung auf Google-Produkte an.

Zuständigkeiten

• Erstellen Sie Auswertungsdatensätze, Autorater und Belohnungsfunktionen, um Gemini-Fähigkeiten zu bewerten und zu verbessern.

• Entwicklung von Benutzersimulatoren zum Testen und Verfeinern von Modellinteraktionen.

• Konstruieren Sie agentische Kabelbäume, die es Modellen ermöglichen, sich mit Optimierungslösern zu verbinden.

• Partner mit Produktbereichen, um Optimierungslöser in ihre Generative AI-Angebote zu integrieren.

• Identifizieren Sie Modellfähigkeitslücken und entwickeln Sie konkrete technische Lösungen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 5 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels en Python.

• 3 ans d'expérience en formation et en ensembles de données d'évaluation pour les modèles d'IA Generative.

• 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la technologie de base des grands modèles linguistiques modernes.

• 3 ans d'expérience en recherche sur l'apprentissage automatique ou en infrastructure d'apprentissage automatique.

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou domaine technique connexe.

• 5 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

• 3 ans d'expérience dans une organisation complexe et matricielle impliquant des projets interfonctionnels ou interprofessionnels.

• Expérience en optimisation combinatoire ou dans d'autres domaines de recherche opérationnelle.

• Expérience du renforcement de l'apprentissage.

Sur le travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Le groupe de recherche opérationnelle construit la technologie pour résoudre les problèmes d'optimisation pour le monde, Alphabet, et Google. Vous rejoindrez une équipe qui travaille à l'intersection de Recherche opérationnelle et Gemini, principalement axée sur l'utilisation des techniques d'optimisation pour améliorer Gemini. Vous aurez soit déjà une connaissance de travail des techniques d'optimisation.
Google Research répond aux défis qui définissent la technologie d'aujourd'hui et de demain. De la recherche fondamentale à l'influence sur le développement de produits, nos équipes de recherche ont la possibilité d'influencer la technologie utilisée par des milliards de personnes chaque jour.

Nos équipes aspirent à faire des découvertes qui touchent tout le monde, et au cœur de notre approche est de partager nos recherches et nos outils pour alimenter les progrès dans le domaine -- nous publions régulièrement dans des revues universitaires, publions des projets comme source ouverte, et appliquons la recherche aux produits Google.

Responsabilités

• Construire des ensembles de données d'évaluation, des autoraters et des fonctions de récompense pour évaluer et améliorer les capacités Gemini.

• Élaborer des simulateurs pour tester et affiner les interactions avec les modèles.

• Construisez des harnais agents qui permettent aux modèles d'interfacer avec des solveurs d'optimisation.

• Partenaire avec les zones de produits pour intégrer des solutions d'optimisation dans leurs offres d'IA Generative.

• Identifier les lacunes des capacités du modèle et concevoir des solutions techniques concrètes.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Graduate of the highest level of secondary school.

• Academic grades in the average of 4.5 or higher.

• Completed Multicheck (Media and Design).

• Ability to communicate in English and German fluently, to interact with stakeholders and schools.

Preferred qualifications:

• Interest in interactive media, digital communication tools, art, or design.

• Enthusiasm and passion for new technologies and tools, demonstrated through personal projects and interest in learning new skills.

• Demonstrated creative problem solving skills and abstract thinking.

• Intention to pursue the Berufsmaturitätsschule (BM1) during the apprenticeship.

• Have authorization to work in Switzerland.

About the job
 A professional team of vocational trainers (Berufsbildner:innen) will guide and support you during your 4-year apprenticeship with Google. After an onboarding period, you will be fully engaged in existing and new projects that will challenge you and lay the foundation for a successful future as an Interactive Media Designer.
 Embedded in our User Experience (UX) Media Design teams, you will focus on the creation and design of new projects. You will rotate between different teams, with different specialities, to understand the range of roles in this fast-growing field.

Responsibilities

• Understand product opportunities through partnership with users, user research, product management, data science, and engineering.

• Understand and incorporate cultural, ethical, and different perspectives to create products that are global.

• Create digital content (e.g., wireframes, mockups, prototypes, presentations) to communicate and progress concepts through to implementation.

• Learn and apply the fundamentals of usability through design and research.

• Develop a craft of high-quality execution according to the highest interaction, interface, and experience design standards.

• L'enthousiasme et la passion pour les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux outils, démontrés par des projets personnels et l'intérêt pour l'apprentissage de nouvelles compétences.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 4 years of interaction design experience in product design or UX design.

• Include a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.

• 1 year of experience leading design projects.

• Experience with Figma and other design tools to produce mockups and prototypes.

• Track record of designing and launching consumer products.

About the job
 At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy-to-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, leveraging user insights to create industry-leading products.

As an Interaction Designer, you'll apply user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences from concept to execution, working with design partners to evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative products.

YouTube Shopping allows viewers to shop products directly from their favorite Creators. We are a rapidly expanding team, with growth goals and a culture for shipping and learning quickly. This role is for the Creator actor, focused on creating tools that empower YouTube creators to share products with their fans and grow their business. As a UX Designer on the team, you will be responsible to help creators grow their businesses by selling their own products or from other brands (affiliates), across many formats (Long video format, Shorts, live streams, posts.
 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements, and provide creative, thoughtful solutions.

• Communicate the user experience at various stages of the design process with wireframes, flow diagrams, storyboards, mockups, or prototypes.

• Advocate for the prioritization of design centered changes, refinements, and improvements.

• Design new shopping experiences for Viewers, including user flows, wireframes, mocks, and functional prototypes.

• Leverage User Experience Researcher (UXR) partnership to deepen the team’s understanding of shopping behavior, decision-making and growing needs.

Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo comune per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e divertiamo — e lo facciamo tutti insieme.

responsabilità

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 4 Jahre Interaktionsdesign-Erfahrung im Produktdesign oder UX-Design.

• Fügen Sie ein Portfolio, eine Website oder einen anderen relevanten Link zu Ihrer Arbeit in Ihren Lebenslauf ein (mit einem sichtbaren Link oder Zugangsanweisungen).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss in Design, Mensch-Computer-Interaktion, Informatik, einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer komplexen, funktionsübergreifenden Organisation.

• 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Leitung von Designprojekten.

• Erfahrung mit Figma und anderen Design-Tools, um Mockups und Prototypen zu produzieren.

• Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung und Einführung von Verbraucherprodukten.

Über den Job
Bei Google konzentrieren wir uns auf den Benutzer und alles andere wird folgen. Unsere Interaction Designer verwandeln komplexe Aufgaben in intuitive, benutzerfreundliche Erlebnisse für Milliarden von Menschen. Vom Erstellen von Benutzerströmen und Wireframes bis hin zum Erstellen von Mockups und Prototypen werden Sie sich Produkterlebnisse mit einem inspirierten, raffinierten und magischen Gefühl vorstellen und zum Leben erwecken. Sie werden unserem multidisziplinären UX-Team beitreten, das mit Engineering und Produktmanagement zusammenarbeitet und Benutzereinblicke nutzt, um branchenführende Produkte zu entwickeln.

Als Interaktionsdesigner wenden Sie benutzerzentrierte Designmethoden an, um branchenführende Benutzererfahrungen vom Konzept bis zur Ausführung zu erstellen, und arbeiten mit Designpartnern zusammen, um die Google-Designsprache zu entwickeln, um schöne, innovative Produkte zu entwickeln.

YouTube Shopping ermöglicht es den Zuschauern, Produkte direkt bei ihren Lieblingsschöpfern einzukaufen. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team mit Wachstumszielen und einer Kultur für Versand und schnelles Lernen. Diese Rolle ist für den Creator-Akteur bestimmt, der sich darauf konzentriert, Tools zu entwickeln, die YouTube-Ersteller dazu befähigen, Produkte mit ihren Fans zu teilen und ihr Geschäft auszubauen. Als UX-Designer im Team sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, Kreativen dabei zu helfen, ihr Geschäft durch den Verkauf ihrer eigenen Produkte oder von anderen Marken (Affiliates) in vielen Formaten (Long Video Format, Shorts, Live-Streams, Posts) auszubauen.
Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und eine Gemeinschaft aufbauen. Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Kraft zu geben, seine Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was er liebt, und sich dabei miteinander zu verbinden. An der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und grenzenloser Kreativität bewegen wir uns mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß - und das alles zusammen.

Zuständigkeiten

• Arbeiten Sie mit Produktmanagern, Ingenieuren und funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern zusammen, um die Anforderungen zu verstehen und kreative, durchdachte Lösungen anzubieten.

• Kommunizieren Sie die Benutzererfahrung in verschiedenen Phasen des Designprozesses mit Wireframes, Flussdiagrammen, Storyboards, Mockups oder Prototypen.

• Befürworten Sie die Priorisierung von designzentrierten Änderungen, Verfeinerungen und Verbesserungen.

• Entwerfen Sie neue Einkaufserlebnisse für Zuschauer, einschließlich Benutzerströme, Wireframes, Mocks und funktionale Prototypen.

• Nutzen Sie die Partnerschaft von User Experience Researcher (UXR), um das Verständnis des Teams für Einkaufsverhalten, Entscheidungsfindung und wachsende Bedürfnisse zu vertiefen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 4 ans d'expérience en conception d'interactions dans la conception de produits ou UX.

• Inclure un portfolio, un site Web ou tout autre lien pertinent à votre travail dans votre CV (fournissant un lien visible ou des instructions d'accès).

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise en conception, interaction homme-ordinateur, informatique, domaine connexe ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 1 an d'expérience à la tête de projets de conception.

• Expérience avec Figma et d'autres outils de conception pour produire des maquettes et des prototypes.

• Suivre l'évolution de la conception et du lancement des produits de consommation.

Sur le travail
Chez Google, nous "Focus sur l'utilisateur et tout le reste suivra." Nos concepteurs d'interaction transforment des tâches complexes en expériences intuitives et faciles à utiliser pour des milliards de personnes. De la création de flux d'utilisateurs et de trames filaires à la construction de maquettes et de prototypes, vous pourrez imaginer et vivre des expériences de produits avec une sensation inspirée, raffinée et magique. Vous vous joindrez à notre équipe multidisciplinaire UX, collaborant avec l'ingénierie et la gestion des produits, en tirant parti des connaissances des utilisateurs pour créer des produits de pointe.

En tant que concepteur d'interactions, vous appliquerez des méthodes de conception centrées sur l'utilisateur à l'artisanat - des expériences utilisateur de pointe du concept à l'exécution, en travaillant avec des partenaires de conception pour développer le langage de conception Google pour construire de beaux produits innovants.

YouTube Shopping permet aux téléspectateurs d'acheter des produits directement auprès de leurs Créateurs préférés. Nous sommes une équipe en expansion rapide, avec des objectifs de croissance et une culture pour l'expédition et l'apprentissage rapide. Ce rôle est pour l'acteur Créateur, axé sur la création d'outils qui permettent aux créateurs YouTube de partager des produits avec leurs fans et de développer leur entreprise. En tant que UX Designer de l'équipe, vous serez responsable d'aider les créateurs à développer leur entreprise en vendant leurs propres produits ou d'autres marques (affiliés), à travers de nombreux formats (Format vidéo long, Shorts, flux en direct, messages.
Sur YouTube, nous croyons que tout le monde mérite d'avoir une voix, et que le monde est un meilleur endroit quand nous écoutons, partageons et construisons la communauté à travers nos histoires. Nous travaillons ensemble pour donner à chacun le pouvoir de partager son histoire, d'explorer ce qu'il aime et de se connecter dans le processus. Travaillant à l'intersection d'une technologie de pointe et d'une créativité illimitée, nous agissons à la vitesse de la culture avec un objectif commun de montrer aux gens le monde. Nous explorons de nouvelles idées, résolvons de vrais problèmes et nous nous amusons — et nous le faisons tous ensemble.

Responsabilités

• Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de produits, les ingénieurs et les intervenants interfonctionnels pour comprendre les exigences et fournir des solutions créatives et réfléchies.

• Communiquer l'expérience utilisateur à différentes étapes du processus de conception avec des trames filaires, des diagrammes de flux, des storyboards, des maquettes ou des prototypes.

• Préconiser l'établissement de priorités pour les changements, les améliorations et les améliorations axés sur la conception.

• Concevoir de nouvelles expériences d'achat pour les téléspectateurs, y compris des flux d'utilisateurs, des trames filaires, des maquettes et des prototypes fonctionnels.

• Tirer parti du partenariat de chercheur d'expérience utilisateur (UXR) pour approfondir la compréhension de l'équipe du comportement d'achat, de la prise de décision et des besoins croissants.
