jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
 Responsibilities

• Write product or system development code.

• Accelerate the deployment of our capabilities to support critical regulatory requirements and key customer engagements, including Google Cloud and DeepMind.

• Partner with cross-functional teams and product groups to seamlessly integrate data protection and policy enforcement components into core infrastructure.

• Build foundational building blocks and shared mechanisms that centralize policy enforcement logic across multiple products and systems.

• Enhance development flows by actively adopting and integrating AI technologies to reduce toil and tech debt, improve productivity, and improve our systems.

• 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici correlati.

• 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e la memorizzazione dei dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. In qualità di ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Con la tua esperienza tecnica gestirai le priorità del progetto, le scadenze e i risultati. Potrai progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni software.
Il team Core costruisce il fondamento tecnico dietro i prodotti di punta di Google. Siamo proprietari e sostenitori per gli elementi di progettazione sottostanti, piattaforme di sviluppo, componenti di prodotto e infrastrutture a Google. Questi sono i mattoni essenziali per esperienze eccellenti, sicure e coerenti per i nostri utenti e guidare il ritmo di innovazione per ogni sviluppatore. Guardiamo attraverso i prodotti di Google per costruire soluzioni centrali, abbattere le barriere tecniche e rafforzare i sistemi esistenti. Come team Core, abbiamo un mandato e un'opportunità unica per influenzare importanti decisioni tecniche in tutta l'azienda.
responsabilità

• Scrivere il codice di sviluppo del prodotto o del sistema.

• Accelera l'implementazione delle nostre capacità per supportare i requisiti normativi critici e gli impegni dei clienti chiave, tra cui Google Cloud e DeepMind.

• Partner con team e gruppi di prodotti interfunzionali per integrare senza soluzione di continuità i componenti di protezione dei dati e di applicazione delle policy nell'infrastruttura di base.

• Costruire blocchi di costruzione fondamentali e meccanismi condivisi che centralizzare la logica di applicazione delle politiche su più prodotti e sistemi.

• Migliorare i flussi di sviluppo adottando e integrando attivamente le tecnologie AI per ridurre i debiti di tecnologia e di tecnologia, migliorare la produttività e migliorare i nostri sistemi.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience with Computer Vision, Generative AI, or Large Language Models.

• One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

• Experience in machine learning, specifically for Generative AI and video applications.

Preferred qualifications:

• 2 years of coding experience.

• 1 year of experience owning and initiating research agendas.

• Experience working on multimodal understanding problems, including image or video understanding tasks.

• Experience working with egocentric data and egocentric problems.

• Experience working in an industry or academic research lab, focusing on multiple aspects of the "research to product" pipeline.

About the job
 As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.
 As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

In this role, you will partner with the Gemini modeling team to make Gemini a powerful AI assistant for existing and upcoming XR devices. Your work will cover multiple aspects of model development and improvement. You will collaborate with data collection teams to source, annotate, and format valuable data, and work to improve overall model performance, robustness, and reliability through advanced training, deployment, and customization techniques. You will possess expertise in developing and improving LLMs for video understanding, ideally with an egocentric focus. This expertise can stem from academic research or direct industry experience.
For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by
breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR
team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where
lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €106000 - €109000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Define the data structure, framework, design, and evaluation metrics for research solution development and implementation under minimal guidance. Identify timelines and obtain resources needed.

• Work on the integration of Gemini into XR products. Design and implement customization layers to enable the next generation of immersive XR experiences powered by Gemini.

• Work together with research teams to highlight model limitations and improve performance in key areas critical for XR applications like spatial and temporal understanding.

• Develop expertise on the full data collection, filtering and pre-processing pipeline to contribute with freshly sourced data to improve the quality of models in egocentric video understanding applications.

• Establish and maintain relationships with main stakeholders and keep recurring updates on the advancements of the project, making sure that their expectations are aligned to the research and engineering work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• PhD in Informatica, un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• Esperienza con Computer Vision, AI Generativo o Modelli di Grande Lingua.

• Una delle più pubblicazioni scientifiche per conferenze, riviste o repository pubblici (come CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ecc.).

• Esperienza nell'apprendimento automatico, in particolare per applicazioni Generative AI e video.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• 2 anni di esperienza di codifica.

• 1 anno di esperienza che possiedono e avviano i programmi di ricerca.

• Esperienza di lavoro su problemi di comprensione multimodale, comprese le attività di comprensione dell'immagine o del video.

• Esperienza di lavoro con dati egocentrici e problemi egocentrici.

• Esperienza di lavoro in un laboratorio di ricerca industriale o accademico, concentrandosi su più aspetti della pipeline "ricerca al prodotto".

Riguardo al lavoro
Come organizzazione, Google mantiene un portafoglio di progetti di ricerca guidati dalla ricerca fondamentale, dalla nuova innovazione del prodotto, dal contributo del prodotto e dagli obiettivi infrastrutturali, fornendo ai singoli e ai team la libertà di sottolineare specifici tipi di lavoro. Come scienziato di ricerca, si istituirà test su larga scala e distribuirà idee promettenti in modo rapido e ampio, gestendo scadenze e consegnabili durante l'applicazione delle ultime teorie per sviluppare nuovi e migliorati prodotti, processi o tecnologie. Dalla creazione di esperimenti e implementazioni di prototipazione alla progettazione di nuove architetture, i nostri scienziati di ricerca lavorano su problemi del mondo reale che abbracciano l'ampiezza della scienza informatica, come l'apprendimento della macchina (e profondo), l'estrazione dei dati, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, l'hardware e l'analisi delle prestazioni del software, il miglioramento dei compilatori per piattaforme mobili, nonché la ricerca del nucleo e molto altro ancora.
Come Ricercatore, contribuirai attivamente anche alla più ampia comunità di ricerca condividendo e pubblicando i tuoi risultati, con idee ispirate a progetti interni e da collaborazioni con programmi di ricerca presso università partner e istituti tecnici di tutto il mondo.

In questo ruolo, sarete partner del team di modellazione Gemini per rendere Gemini un potente assistente AI per i dispositivi XR esistenti e prossimi. Il vostro lavoro coprirà più aspetti dello sviluppo e del miglioramento del modello. Collaborerai con i team di raccolta dati per generare, annotare e formattare dati preziosi, e lavorerai per migliorare le prestazioni del modello generale, la robustezza e l'affidabilità attraverso tecniche di formazione, distribuzione e personalizzazione avanzate. Possiederai competenze nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento di LLM per la comprensione video, idealmente con un focus egocentrico. Questa esperienza può derivare dalla ricerca accademica o dall'esperienza diretta del settore.
Per decenni, la rivoluzione informatica ha rimodellato il nostro mondo guidato da
innovazioni in elaborazione, connettività, mobile, e ora, AI. Google XR
team è all'avanguardia del prossimo grande salto – la convergenza di AI e XR. Questo è più di nuovi dispositivi – si tratta di riimmaginare come interagiamo con il mondo che ci circonda. Stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui
dispositivi XR leggeri come occhiali intelligenti e cuffie coppia con AI utile per aumentare l'intelligenza umana, offrendo esperienze personalizzate, conversazioni e contestualmente consapevoli. La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti.

Germania: €106000 - €109000 (EUR) + 15% target bonus + equità + prestazioni

Scopri di più sui vantaggi di Google .
responsabilità

• Definire la struttura dei dati, la struttura, la progettazione e le metriche di valutazione per lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di soluzioni di ricerca sotto una guida minima. Identificare tempi e ottenere risorse necessarie.

• Lavorare sull'integrazione di Gemini nei prodotti XR. Progettare e implementare strati di personalizzazione per consentire la prossima generazione di esperienze XR immersive alimentate da Gemini.

• Lavorare insieme a team di ricerca per evidenziare i limiti del modello e migliorare le prestazioni in aree chiave critiche per applicazioni XR come la comprensione spaziale e temporale.

• Sviluppare competenze sulla raccolta completa dei dati, filtraggio e pre-elaborazione pipeline per contribuire con i dati appena generati per migliorare la qualità dei modelli nelle applicazioni di comprensione video egocentrica.

• Stabilire e mantenere le relazioni con i principali stakeholder e mantenere aggiornamenti ricorrenti sui progressi del progetto, assicurandosi che le loro aspettative siano allineate al lavoro di ricerca e ingegneria.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in software development.

• 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.

• 5 years of experience in power or performance modeling or system performance analysis.

• 5 years of experience with Linux Kernel development and software and hardware architecture.

• 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

• 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.

• Deep expertise in at least some of the following: operating systems, networking systems, storage systems, analytics, machine learning, working with distributed query processing and deep functional flows.

About the job
 At DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission-driven team.

Accelerators have become a strategic differentiator in today’s hyperscale AI competition. Unlike classic data center infrastructure, these new codesigned systems must meet future demands as our workloads continue to evolve and mutate. Through our projects, we are deploying new hardware in Google data centers to drive enhanced capabilities and efficiency, partnering closely with the teams responsible for Google’s technical infrastructure to successfully deliver these systems.
 We are a co-design team within DeepMind’s GenAI Systems, operating across Google’s vertically integrated stack. Our expertise spans hardware including architecture, logic design, design verification, and physical design software, such as compilation, performance optimization, libraries, operating systems, and kernels, and algorithms, covering ML model design, optimization methods, numerics, and sparsity. In these fields, we conduct research while delivering production-quality hardware and software products.
 Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
 We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Write low-level performance software for a new systolic array accelerators.

• Identify high-value algorithms and problems that are a match to this new machines.

• Use that direct experience delivering production code to build programming infrastructure to ease programming on the new accelerator for the performance software engineers and general software engineers who follow.

• Collaborate with application, algorithm, and performance-tuning experts to codesign solutions for the best efficiency, performance, and programmability.

• Communicate the performance, programmability, and efficiency results to our team and to our partner teams.

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del software.

• 5 anni di test di esperienza e lancio di prodotti software.

• 5 anni di esperienza nella modellazione della potenza o delle prestazioni o nell'analisi delle prestazioni del sistema.

• 5 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo Linux Kernel e l'architettura software e hardware.

• 3 anni di esperienza con progettazione e architettura software.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Ingegneria, Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.

• 8 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• 3 anni di esperienza che lavorano in un complesso, matrice organizzazione che coinvolge progetti interfunzionali o cross-business.

• 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica leader team di progetto e la definizione di direzione tecnica.

• Profonda esperienza in almeno alcuni dei seguenti: sistemi operativi, sistemi di rete, sistemi di storage, analisi, machine learning, lavorando con processi di query distribuiti e flussi funzionali profondi.

Riguardo al lavoro
A DeepMind la nostra missione è quella di costruire il primo agente di apprendimento generale del mondo. Centrale a questa missione è il complesso compito di misurare l'intelligenza dei nostri prototipi. Come Ingegnere di Software, lavorerai con gli agenti AI all'avanguardia sviluppati dal nostro eccezionale team di scienziati di ricerca di Machine Learning e Neuroscience. Le tue responsabilità includono tutto, dalla creazione di sistemi per test di agente utilizzando giochi 2D e 3D per lo sviluppo di problemi di test all'interno dei simulatori di fisica. Si creerà la visualizzazione grafica dei risultati, costruire classifiche di agenti competitivi e testare nuovi algoritmi sui robot. Per avere successo in questo ruolo è necessario avere una solida base nell'ingegneria del software e godere di lavorare su una vasta gamma di problemi impegnativi all'interno di un team guidato dalla missione.

Gli acceleratori sono diventati un differenziatore strategico nella competizione AI di oggi. A differenza dell'infrastruttura data center classica, questi nuovi sistemi codesigned devono soddisfare le esigenze future in quanto i nostri carichi di lavoro continuano ad evolversi e mutare. Attraverso i nostri progetti, stiamo implementando un nuovo hardware nei data center di Google per guidare funzionalità ed efficienza migliorate, collaborando strettamente con i team responsabili dell’infrastruttura tecnica di Google per fornire con successo questi sistemi.
Siamo un team di co-design all'interno dei sistemi GenAI di DeepMind, che opera attraverso lo stack verticalmente integrato di Google. La nostra esperienza si estende su hardware tra cui architettura, progettazione logica, verifica del design e software di progettazione fisica, come compilazione, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, librerie, sistemi operativi e kernel, e algoritmi, che coprono la progettazione del modello ML, metodi di ottimizzazione, numerici e sparsità. In questi campi, conduciamo la ricerca durante la fornitura di prodotti hardware e software di qualità di produzione.
L’intelligenza artificiale sarà una delle invenzioni più trasformative dell’umanità. A Google DeepMind, siamo un laboratorio AI pionieristico con team interdisciplinari eccezionali focalizzati sull'avanzamento dello sviluppo AI per risolvere complesse sfide globali e accelerare l'innovazione di prodotto di alta qualità per miliardi di utenti. Utilizziamo le nostre tecnologie per un ampio beneficio pubblico e una scoperta scientifica, assicurando la sicurezza e l'etica sono sempre la nostra massima priorità.
Stiamo spingendo i confini attraverso più domini. I nostri team globali offrono diverse opportunità di apprendimento e percorsi di carriera diversificati per coloro che sono spinti a raggiungere risultati eccezionali attraverso lo sforzo collettivo.
La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% target bonus + equity + benefici

Scopri di più sui vantaggi di Google .
responsabilità

• Scrivere software di prestazione a basso livello per un nuovo acceleratore di array sistolico.

• Identificare algoritmi e problemi di alto valore che corrispondono a queste nuove macchine.

• Utilizzare l'esperienza diretta che fornisce il codice di produzione per costruire l'infrastruttura di programmazione per facilitare la programmazione sul nuovo acceleratore per gli ingegneri del software di performance e gli ingegneri del software generale che seguono.

• Collabora con esperti di applicazione, algoritmo e performance-tuning per coprogettare soluzioni per la migliore efficienza, performance e programmabilità.

• Comunicare i risultati di performance, programmabilità e efficienza al nostro team e ai nostri team partner.

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung beim Testen und Launchen von Softwareprodukten.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leistungs- oder Leistungsmodellierung oder Systemleistungsanalyse.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Linux Kernel Entwicklung und Software- und Hardware-Architektur.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Software-Design und Architektur.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer komplexen, matrixförmigen Organisation mit funktionsübergreifenden oder geschäftsübergreifenden Projekten.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer technischen Führungsrolle, die Projektteams leitet und die technische Ausrichtung festlegt.

• Tiefe Expertise in mindestens einigen der folgenden Bereiche: Betriebssysteme, Netzwerksysteme, Speichersysteme, Analytik, maschinelles Lernen, Arbeit mit verteilter Abfrageverarbeitung und tiefe funktionale Abläufe.

Über den Job
Bei DeepMind ist es unsere Mission, den weltweit ersten Universal Learning Agent zu bauen. Im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission steht die komplexe Aufgabe, die Intelligenz unserer Prototypen zu messen. Als Software Engineer arbeiten Sie mit hochmodernen KI-Agenten zusammen, die von unserem außergewöhnlichen Team aus Wissenschaftlern aus den Bereichen Machine Learning und Neurowissenschaften entwickelt wurden. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen alles, von der Erstellung von Systemen für Agententests mit 2D- und 3D-Spielen bis hin zur Entwicklung von Testproblemen in Physiksimulatoren. Sie erstellen eine grafische Visualisierung der Ergebnisse, erstellen Bestenlisten für Wettbewerbsagenten und testen neue Algorithmen an Robotern. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, müssen Sie eine starke Grundlage im Software-Engineering haben und Spaß daran haben, an einer Vielzahl von herausfordernden Problemen in einem missionsgesteuerten Team zu arbeiten.

Beschleuniger sind zu einem strategischen Unterscheidungsmerkmal im heutigen Hyperscale-KI-Wettbewerb geworden. Im Gegensatz zur klassischen Rechenzentrumsinfrastruktur müssen diese neuen, mitgestalteten Systeme die zukünftigen Anforderungen erfüllen, da sich unsere Workloads weiterentwickeln und mutieren. Durch unsere Projekte setzen wir neue Hardware in Google-Rechenzentren ein, um die Fähigkeiten und Effizienz zu verbessern, und arbeiten eng mit den Teams zusammen, die für die technische Infrastruktur von Google verantwortlich sind, um diese Systeme erfolgreich bereitzustellen.
Wir sind ein Co-Design-Team innerhalb der GenAI-Systeme von DeepMind und arbeiten über den vertikal integrierten Stack von Google. Unsere Expertise erstreckt sich auf Hardware, einschließlich Architektur, Logikdesign, Designverifikation und physische Designsoftware, wie Compilation, Performance-Optimierung, Bibliotheken, Betriebssysteme und Kernel sowie Algorithmen, die ML-Modelldesign, Optimierungsmethoden, Zahlen und Sparsity abdecken. In diesen Bereichen forschen wir und liefern gleichzeitig Hardware- und Softwareprodukte in Produktionsqualität.
Künstliche Intelligenz wird eine der transformativsten Erfindungen der Menschheit sein. Bei Google DeepMind sind wir ein wegweisendes KI-Labor mit außergewöhnlichen interdisziplinären Teams, die sich darauf konzentrieren, die KI-Entwicklung voranzutreiben, um komplexe globale Herausforderungen zu lösen und qualitativ hochwertige Produktinnovationen für Milliarden von Nutzern zu beschleunigen. Wir nutzen unsere Technologien für den breiten öffentlichen Nutzen und wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen, Sicherheit und Ethik sind immer unsere höchste Priorität.
Wir verschieben die Grenzen über mehrere Domänen hinweg. Unsere globalen Teams bieten vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und vielfältige Karrierewege für diejenigen, die durch gemeinsame Anstrengungen außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielen wollen.
Die individuelle Bezahlung wird durch Faktoren wie berufsbezogene Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und relevante Bildung oder Ausbildung bestimmt.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% Bonusziel + Eigenkapital + Vorteile

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Vorteile bei Google.
Zuständigkeiten

• Schreiben Sie eine Low-Level-Performance-Software für neue systolische Array-Beschleuniger.

• Identifizieren Sie hochwertige Algorithmen und Probleme, die zu diesen neuen Maschinen passen.

• Nutzen Sie diese direkte Erfahrung bei der Bereitstellung von Produktionscode, um eine Programmierinfrastruktur aufzubauen, um die Programmierung auf dem neuen Beschleuniger für die folgenden Performance-Software-Ingenieure und allgemeinen Software-Ingenieure zu vereinfachen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Anwendungs-, Algorithmus- und Performance-Tuning-Experten zusammen, um Lösungen für die beste Effizienz, Leistung und Programmierbarkeit zu entwerfen.

• Kommunizieren Sie die Leistung, Programmierbarkeit und Effizienzergebnisse an unser Team und an unsere Partnerteams.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 8 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels.

• 5 ans d'expérience et lancement de logiciels.

• 5 ans d'expérience en modélisation de puissance ou de performance ou en analyse de performance du système.

• 5 ans d'expérience avec le développement de noyau Linux et l'architecture logicielle et matérielle.

• 3 ans d'expérience dans la conception et l'architecture de logiciels.

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en génie, informatique ou domaine technique connexe.

• 8 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

• 3 ans d'expérience dans une organisation complexe et matricielle impliquant des projets interfonctionnels ou interprofessionnels.

• 3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de leadership technique des équipes de projet et la mise en place de la direction technique.

• Une expertise approfondie dans au moins quelques-uns des domaines suivants : systèmes d'exploitation, systèmes de réseautage, systèmes de stockage, analyse, apprentissage automatique, travail avec le traitement des requêtes distribuées et flux fonctionnels profonds.

Sur le travail
À DeepMind, notre mission est de construire le premier agent d'apprentissage général au monde. La tâche complexe de mesurer l'intelligence de nos prototypes est au cœur de cette mission. En tant qu'ingénieur en logiciels, vous travaillerez avec les agents d'IA de pointe développés par notre équipe exceptionnelle de chercheurs en apprentissage automatique et en neurosciences. Vos responsabilités comprendront tout, de la création de systèmes pour les tests d'agents à l'aide de jeux 2D et 3D au développement de problèmes de test au sein des simulateurs de physique. Vous créerez une visualisation graphique des résultats, créerez des classements d'agents compétitifs et testerez de nouveaux algorithmes sur les robots. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin d'avoir une base solide en génie logiciel et profiter de travailler sur un large éventail de problèmes difficiles au sein d'une équipe axée sur la mission.

Les accélérateurs sont devenus un différenciateur stratégique dans aujourd'hui la compétition hyperéchelle AI. Contrairement à l'infrastructure classique des centres de données, ces nouveaux systèmes codés doivent répondre aux exigences futures à mesure que nos charges de travail continuent d'évoluer et de muter. Grâce à nos projets, nous déployons de nouveaux équipements dans les data centers de Google pour améliorer les capacités et l'efficacité, en partenariat étroit avec les équipes responsables de l'infrastructure technique de Google.
Nous sommes une équipe de co-conception au sein de DeepMind. Notre expertise couvre le matériel, y compris l'architecture, la conception logique, la vérification de conception, et les logiciels de conception physique, tels que la compilation, l'optimisation des performances, les bibliothèques, les systèmes d'exploitation et les noyaux, et les algorithmes, couvrant la conception de modèles ML, les méthodes d'optimisation, les numériques et la sparsity. Dans ces domaines, nous menons des recherches tout en fournissant du matériel et des logiciels de qualité de production.
L'intelligence artificielle sera l'une des inventions les plus transformatrices de l'humanité. Chez Google DeepMind, nous sommes un laboratoire d'IA pionnier avec des équipes interdisciplinaires exceptionnelles axées sur le développement de l'IA pour résoudre des défis mondiaux complexes et accélérer l'innovation de produits de haute qualité pour des milliards d'utilisateurs. Nous utilisons nos technologies à des fins d'intérêt général et de découverte scientifique, en veillant à ce que la sécurité et l'éthique soient toujours notre priorité absolue.
Nous repoussons les frontières entre plusieurs domaines. Nos équipes mondiales offrent diverses possibilités d'apprentissage et des parcours de carrière variés pour ceux qui sont motivés par des résultats exceptionnels grâce à des efforts collectifs.
La rémunération individuelle est déterminée par des facteurs tels que les compétences professionnelles, l'expérience et les études ou la formation pertinentes.

États-Unis : 207000 $ - 300000 $ (USD) + 20% de bonus + capitaux propres + avantages

En savoir plus sur les avantages chez Google .
Responsabilités

• Écrire un logiciel de faible performance pour un nouveau tableau systolique.

• Identifier les algorithmes de haute valeur et les problèmes qui correspondent à ces nouvelles machines.

• Utilisez cette expérience directe de livraison de code de production pour construire l'infrastructure de programmation pour faciliter la programmation sur le nouvel accélérateur pour les ingénieurs de logiciels de performance et les ingénieurs de logiciels généraux qui suivent.

• Collaborez avec des experts en application, en algorithme et en réglage des performances à la conception de solutions pour la meilleure efficacité, performance et programmabilité.

• Communiquer les résultats de performance, de programmation et d'efficacité à notre équipe et à nos équipes partenaires.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of experience in business development, partnerships, management consulting, or investment banking, in the mobile network operator/OEM industry.

• Experience working with C-level executives and cross-functionally across all levels of management.

• Experience managing agreements or partnerships.

• Ability to travel internationally up to 20% as required.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in market or business development, engaging with telco channels, retailers, OEMs, Pay-TV industry, building business plans and negotiating agreements, drive growth through strategic thinking and deep partnerships.

• Experience with international consulting and knowledge of app/content ecosystem.

• Ability to represent Google in agreement discussions and structure terms to achieve strong ongoing partner alignment.

• Ability to interpret legal documents and work with attorneys on specific agreement language.

• Ability to analyze and structure complex agreements with excellent negotiation and execution skills.

• Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to liaise with partners.

About the job
 Android is the world's most popular operating system in history with more than three billion users worldwide. The Android team at Google has built that reality over the past 18 years, in partnership with a global network of industry leading companies and individuals to form the Android ecosystem. The Platform and Devices Partnerships team at Google manages that ecosystem. We help partners realize the mutual benefit from making, distributing and connecting Android-based products for users throughout the world. The team's mission is to grow premium Android users sustainably, driving delightful Android experiences and enabling higher business generation through technology and commercial partnerships.
 As a Strategic Partnerships Development Manager for Android and Telco Partnerships in EMEA, you will be at the forefront of driving growth for Android and Platform and Devices product areas across the Telco/OEM sector.
 You will be responsible for designing partnership strategies, and executing complex agreements that are critical to drive the user acquisition and business generation efforts in the region with partners.
 This is a dynamic role that requires a blend of strategic thinking, business acumen and a passion for technology. You will collaborate with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to bring new and exciting Android experiences to millions of users.
If you are a relationship builder, a strategic negotiator, and a project management expert who thrives on making a significant impact, this is the perfect opportunity for you. The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product-enabling partnerships, go-to-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.

Responsibilities

Android ist das weltweit beliebteste Betriebssystem in der Geschichte mit mehr als drei Milliarden Nutzern weltweit. Android est le système d'exploitation le plus populaire au monde dans l'histoire avec plus de trois milliards d'utilisateurs dans le monde. • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of sales experience in the technology industry with SaaS, PaaS or IaaS products and platforms.

• Experience engaging with accounts, selling a portfolio of products at C-level.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with large, complex commercial and legal negotiations working with procurement, legal, and business teams.

• Experience promoting Google Cloud computing technologies to large and complex organizations across geographies.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and import and export talent and ideas to achieve a broader organizational goal.

• Ability to influence decisions at the executive level.

• Ability to present analyses and break down technical concepts into simple terms to present to technical and non-technical audiences.

About the job
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
 Responsibilities

• Build and deepen executive relationships with enterprise customers; bring to Google your mature CxO relationships to help us grow into new organizations.

• Manage end-to-end complex sales-cycles, often presenting to C-level executives in corporate customers.

• Lead account strategy in generating and developing business growth opportunities, working collaboratively with Customer Engineers, and Google Partners.

• Understand each customer’s technology footprint, growth plans and business drivers, technology strategy and external landscape.

• Drive business development, forecast accurately, and achieve goals by leading customers through the entire business cycle.

• Fähigkeit, Analysen zu präsentieren und technische Konzepte in einfache Begriffe zu zerlegen, um sie dem technischen und nicht-technischen Publikum zu präsentieren.

Über den Job
Das Google Cloud Platform-Team hilft Kunden, das zu transformieren und zu bauen, was für ihr Unternehmen als nächstes kommt - alles mit der in der Cloud integrierten Technologie. Unsere Produkte sind auf Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Skalierbarkeit ausgerichtet und führen den gesamten Stapel von der Infrastruktur über Anwendungen bis hin zu Geräten und Hardware aus. Unsere Teams unterstützen unsere Kunden - Entwickler, kleine und große Unternehmen, Bildungseinrichtungen und Regierungsbehörden - dabei, die Vorteile unserer Technologie zum Leben zu erwecken. Als Teil eines unternehmerischen Teams in diesem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle beim Verständnis der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und helfen, die Zukunft von Unternehmen jeder Größe mithilfe von Technologie mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Partnern zu verbinden.
Google Cloud beschleunigt die Fähigkeit jedes Unternehmens, sein Geschäft und seine Branche digital zu verändern. Wir liefern Lösungen für Unternehmen, die die modernste Technologie von Google nutzen, und Tools, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre wichtigsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen.
Zuständigkeiten

• Bauen und vertiefen Sie Führungsbeziehungen mit Unternehmenskunden; bringen Sie Ihre reifen CxO-Beziehungen zu Google, um uns zu helfen, in neue Organisationen zu wachsen.

• Verwalten Sie komplexe End-to-End-Verkaufszyklen und präsentieren Sie sie oft C-Level-Führungskräften in Firmenkunden.

• Lead-Account-Strategie bei der Generierung und Entwicklung von Geschäftswachstumsmöglichkeiten in Zusammenarbeit mit Kundeningenieuren und Google-Partnern.

• Verstehen Sie den technologischen Fußabdruck jedes Kunden, Wachstumspläne und Geschäftstreiber, Technologiestrategie und externe Landschaft.

• Fördern Sie die Geschäftsentwicklung, prognostizieren Sie genau und erreichen Sie Ziele, indem Sie Kunden durch den gesamten Geschäftszyklus führen.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science or a related technical field in the EMEA region, and in your penultimate/final year of education.

• Experience in one or more Research areas: Natural Language Understanding/Processing, Computer Vision, LLMs, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Mining, Machine Intelligence, AI/ML Algorithms, Deep Learning or Image Processing, multimodal, multilingual and reinforcement learning.

• Experience and profiency in one or more general purpose programming languages: Java, C++, Python, or Go.

• Experience with research from previous internships, full-time industry experience, personal projects, lab work, or published papers (being listed as author).

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.

• Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in conferences or journals.

• Ability to design and execute on research agendas.

• Ability to complete a 13-17 week full-time internship in Switzerland, France or Germany starting in either May, June or July 2027.

About the job
 Research happens at Google everyday, on many different embedded teams throughout the company. Our research reaches the user through both services and products such as Search, Maps, Google Assistant, Google Translate, Google Cloud, and our computing, storage, and networking infrastructure. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest technologies that push the boundaries of what is possible. At Google, research-focused engineering interns are embedded throughout the company, contributing to the setup of large-scale tests and deploying promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing architectures, research-focused engineering interns work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and more.
 Google Research addresses challenges that define the technology of today and tomorrow. From conducting fundamental research to influencing product development, our research teams have the opportunity to impact technology used by billions of people every day.

Our teams aspire to make discoveries that impact everyone, and core to our approach is sharing our research and tools to fuel progress in the field -- we publish regularly in academic journals, release projects as open source, and apply research to Google products.
 Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
 France: €66000 (EUR) + 0% bonus target
 Denmark: kr.670000 (DKK) + 0% bonus target
 Learn more about benefits at Google .

Responsibilities

• Participate in research to develop solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.

• Research, conceive, and develop software applications to extend and improve on Google's product offering.

• Contribute to a wide variety of projects utilizing natural language processing, artificial intelligence, data compression, machine learning, and search technologies.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Attualmente iscritta in un dottorato di ricerca in Informatica o in un campo tecnico correlato nella regione EMEA, e nel vostro penultimo/ultimo anno di istruzione.

• Esperienza in uno o più ambiti di ricerca: Comprensione/Processsing del linguaggio naturale, Visione del computer, LLM, Fondazioni algoritmiche di ottimizzazione, Data Mining, Machine Intelligence, Algoritmi AI/ML, Deep Learning or Image Processing, apprendimento multimodale, multilingue e rafforzamento dell'apprendimento.

• Esperienza e competenza in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione generali: Java, C++, Python o Go.

• Esperienza con la ricerca di stage precedenti, esperienza nel settore a tempo pieno, progetti personali, lavoro di laboratorio o pubblicazioni (essere elencati come autore).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Esperienza come ricercatore, tra cui stage, a tempo pieno, o in un laboratorio.

• Esperienza contribuendo a comunità o sforzi di ricerca, tra cui pubblicazioni in conferenze o riviste.

• Capacità di progettare ed eseguire in agenda di ricerca.

• Capacità di completare un tirocinio di 13-17 settimane a tempo pieno in Svizzera, Francia o Germania a partire da maggio, giugno o luglio 2027.

Riguardo al lavoro
La ricerca avviene ogni giorno su Google, su molte diverse squadre incorporate in tutta la società. La nostra ricerca raggiunge l'utente attraverso servizi e prodotti come ricerca, mappe, Google Assistant, Google Translate, Google Cloud, e la nostra infrastruttura di elaborazione, archiviazione e networking. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, stiamo lavorando su progetti che utilizzano le ultime tecnologie che spingono i confini di ciò che è possibile. A Google, gli stagisti di ingegneria focalizzati sulla ricerca sono incorporati in tutta l'azienda, contribuendo alla messa a punto di test su larga scala e la distribuzione di idee promettenti in modo rapido e ampio. Le idee possono provenire da progetti interni e da collaborazioni con programmi di ricerca presso università partner e istituti tecnici in tutto il mondo. Dalla creazione di esperimenti e implementazioni di prototipazione alla progettazione di architetture, intern ingegneristici focalizzati sulla ricerca lavorano su problemi del mondo reale, tra cui intelligenza artificiale, data mining, elaborazione della lingua naturale, analisi hardware e software delle prestazioni, migliorare compilatori per piattaforme mobili, così come la ricerca del core e altro ancora.
Google Research affronta le sfide che definiscono la tecnologia di oggi e di domani. Dal condurre una ricerca fondamentale per influenzare lo sviluppo del prodotto, i nostri team di ricerca hanno l'opportunità di influenzare la tecnologia utilizzata da miliardi di persone ogni giorno.

I nostri team aspirano a fare scoperte che colpiscono tutti, e core al nostro approccio sta condividendo la nostra ricerca e strumenti per alimentare il progresso nel campo -- pubblichiamo regolarmente in riviste accademiche, rilasciano progetti come open source, e applichiamo la ricerca ai prodotti di Google.

responsabilità

• Partecipare alla ricerca per sviluppare soluzioni per problemi reali e su larga scala.

• Ricerca, concepimento e sviluppo di applicazioni software per estendere e migliorare l'offerta di prodotti di Google.

• Contribuisci a una vasta gamma di progetti che utilizzano l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, l'intelligenza artificiale, la compressione dei dati, l'apprendimento automatico e le tecnologie di ricerca.

Mindestqualifikationen:

• Derzeit in einem PhD-Abschluss in Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich in der EMEA-Region und in Ihrem vorletzten / letzten Bildungsjahr eingeschrieben.

• Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren Forschungsbereichen: Natural Language Understanding/Processing, Computer Vision, LLMs, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Mining, Machine Intelligence, AI/ML Algorithms, Deep Learning oder Image Processing, multimodales, mehrsprachiges und Reinforcement Learning.

• Erfahrung und Kenntnisse in einer oder mehreren allgemeinen Programmiersprachen: Java, C++, Python oder Go.

• Erfahrung mit Forschung aus früheren Praktika, Vollzeit-Branchenerfahrung, persönliche Projekte, Laborarbeit oder veröffentlichte Arbeiten (als Autor aufgeführt).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Erfahrung als Forscher, einschließlich Praktika, Vollzeit oder in einem Labor.

• Erfahrung als Beitrag zu Forschungsgemeinschaften oder -bemühungen, einschließlich der Veröffentlichung von Artikeln in Konferenzen oder Zeitschriften.

• Fähigkeit, Forschungsagenden zu entwerfen und auszuführen.

• Möglichkeit, ein 13-17-wöchiges Vollzeitpraktikum in der Schweiz, Frankreich oder Deutschland ab Mai, Juni oder Juli 2027 zu absolvieren.

Über den Job
Forschung findet bei Google jeden Tag, auf viele verschiedene eingebettete Teams im ganzen Unternehmen. Unsere Forschung erreicht den Benutzer sowohl über Dienste als auch über Produkte wie Search, Maps, Google Assistant, Google Translate, Google Cloud und unsere Computer-, Speicher- und Netzwerkinfrastruktur. Um dies zu erreichen, arbeiten wir an Projekten, die die neuesten Technologien nutzen, die die Grenzen des Möglichen erweitern. Bei Google sind forschungsorientierte Ingenieurpraktikanten im gesamten Unternehmen integriert, tragen zur Einrichtung von groß angelegten Tests bei und setzen vielversprechende Ideen schnell und breit ein. Ideen können aus internen Projekten sowie aus Kooperationen mit Forschungsprogrammen an Partneruniversitäten und technischen Instituten auf der ganzen Welt stammen. Von der Erstellung von Experimenten und Prototyping-Implementierungen bis hin zur Gestaltung von Architekturen arbeiten forschungsorientierte Ingenieurpraktikanten an realen Problemen wie künstlicher Intelligenz, Data Mining, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, Hardware- und Software-Leistungsanalyse, Verbesserung von Compilern für mobile Plattformen sowie Kernsuche und mehr.
Google Research adressiert Herausforderungen, die die Technologie von heute und morgen definieren. Von der Grundlagenforschung bis hin zur Beeinflussung der Produktentwicklung haben unsere Forschungsteams die Möglichkeit, die Technologie zu beeinflussen, die täglich von Milliarden von Menschen genutzt wird.

Unsere Teams streben nach Entdeckungen, die alle betreffen, und der Kern unseres Ansatzes ist es, unsere Forschung und Werkzeuge zu teilen, um Fortschritte in diesem Bereich zu erzielen - wir veröffentlichen regelmäßig in akademischen Zeitschriften, veröffentlichen Projekte als Open Source und wenden Forschung auf Google-Produkte an.

Zuständigkeiten

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Forschung, um Lösungen für reale, große Probleme zu entwickeln.

• Recherchieren, konzipieren und entwickeln Sie Softwareanwendungen, um das Produktangebot von Google zu erweitern und zu verbessern.

• Tragen Sie zu einer Vielzahl von Projekten bei, die natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, künstliche Intelligenz, Datenkomprimierung, maschinelles Lernen und Suchtechnologien nutzen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Actuellement inscrit à un doctorat en informatique ou un domaine technique connexe dans la région de l'EMEA, et dans votre avant-dernière année de formation.

• Expérience dans un ou plusieurs domaines de recherche : compréhension/traitement du langage naturel, vision informatique, LLM, Fondations algorithmiques d'optimisation, d'extraction de données, d'intelligence automatique, d'algorithmes AI/ML, d'apprentissage profond ou de traitement d'image, d'apprentissage multimodal, multilingue et de renforcement.

• Expérience et profience dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation généraux : Java, C++, Python ou Go.

• Expérience de la recherche tirée de stages antérieurs, expérience à temps plein dans l'industrie, projets personnels, travaux de laboratoire ou articles publiés (qui figurent sur la liste des auteurs).

Titres préférés:

• Expérience de chercheur, y compris des stages, à temps plein ou dans un laboratoire.

• Expérience de la contribution aux communautés ou aux efforts de recherche, y compris la publication de documents dans des conférences ou des revues.

• Capacité de concevoir et d'exécuter des programmes de recherche.

• Capacité à effectuer un stage à temps plein de 13 à 17 semaines en Suisse, en France ou en Allemagne à partir de mai, juin ou juillet 2027.

Sur le travail
La recherche se fait à Google tous les jours, sur de nombreuses équipes intégrées différentes dans toute l'entreprise. Nos recherches parviennent à l'utilisateur à travers des services et des produits tels que Search, Maps, Google Assistant, Google Translate, Google Cloud, et notre infrastructure informatique, de stockage et de réseautage. Pour y parvenir, nous travaillons sur des projets qui utilisent les dernières technologies qui repoussent les limites de ce qui est possible. Chez Google, des stagiaires en ingénierie axés sur la recherche sont intégrés dans toute l'entreprise, contribuant à la mise en place de tests à grande échelle et déployant des idées prometteuses rapidement et largement. Les idées peuvent provenir de projets internes ainsi que de collaborations avec des programmes de recherche dans des universités et des instituts techniques partenaires du monde entier. De la création d'expériences et d'implémentations de prototypage à la conception d'architectures, les stagiaires en ingénierie axés sur la recherche travaillent sur des problèmes réels tels que l'intelligence artificielle, l'extraction de données, le traitement du langage naturel, l'analyse des performances du matériel et des logiciels, l'amélioration des compilateurs pour les plateformes mobiles, ainsi que la recherche de base et plus encore.
Google Research répond aux défis qui définissent la technologie d'aujourd'hui et de demain. De la recherche fondamentale à l'influence sur le développement de produits, nos équipes de recherche ont la possibilité d'influencer la technologie utilisée par des milliards de personnes chaque jour.

Nos équipes aspirent à faire des découvertes qui touchent tout le monde, et au cœur de notre approche est de partager nos recherches et nos outils pour alimenter les progrès dans le domaine -- nous publions régulièrement dans des revues universitaires, publions des projets comme source ouverte, et appliquons la recherche aux produits Google.

Responsabilités

• Participer à la recherche pour trouver des solutions aux problèmes réels et à grande échelle.

• Rechercher, concevoir et développer des applications logicielles pour étendre et améliorer l'offre de produits de Google.

• Contribuer à une grande variété de projets utilisant le traitement du langage naturel, l'intelligence artificielle, la compression des données, l'apprentissage automatique et les technologies de recherche.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience in product management, or a related technical role.

• 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in a technology or business related field.

• Experience getting things done in large matrixed organizations.

• Experience building AI native product experiences.

• Experience building enterprise and consumer facing products.

• High agency and accountability.

About the job
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Time management comprise Google Calendar and Tasks - the goal of these is to help users make the most of their time.
 They are a key part of Google Workspace . Both are available on Web, Android and iOS with a robust third-party developer ecosystem.
 We want to help people make time for what matters most by making it easy for users to plan time for them and their collaborators, and execute on their goals.
 We see Calendar and Tasks as primitives that should be deeply integrated into everyday journeys across Workspace and Google.
 Calendar and Tasks must meet the needs of varied stakeholders - from consumers through to C-suite execs, their ABPs, knowledge workers, IT admins, partners and developers.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
 Responsibilities

• User and Market Insights: Partner with UX/UXR to deeply understand target personas and contexts, while analyzing productivity market landscapes and competitive dynamics.

• Product Strategy: Engage directly with customers to identify pain points, validate solutions, and translate insights into actionable product concepts.

• Technical Leadership: Inspire engineering teams to build and deploy complex software solutions, focusing on architectural modernization through Machine Learning (ML) and Large Language Models (LLMs).

• AI-First Development: Advocate an AI-centric approach by collaborating cross-functionally to define robust evaluations and measure the ongoing quality of AI-powered features.

• Execution and Visibility: Manage feature backlogs, prioritize team workloads, and act as the primary representative of the team's work to Director+ executives.

descriptionByLocale.it:

• 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, o un ruolo tecnico correlato.

• 5 anni di esperienza nel prendere prodotti tecnici dal concepimento al lancio (ad esempio, ideazione all'esecuzione, end-to-end, 0 a 1, ecc.).

• Laurea magistrale in un campo tecnologico o commerciale.

• Esperienza ottenere le cose fatte in grandi organizzazioni matrici.

• Esperienza di costruzione AI esperienze di prodotto nativo.

• Esperienza costruzione impresa e prodotti di fronte al consumatore.

• Alta agenzia e responsabilità.

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google, mettiamo i nostri utenti prima. Il mondo cambia sempre, quindi abbiamo bisogno di Product Manager che si adattano continuamente ed emozionano a lavorare su prodotti che colpiscono milioni di persone ogni giorno.

In questo ruolo, lavorerai trasversalmente per guidare i prodotti dal concepimento al lancio collegando i mondi tecnici e aziendali. È possibile abbattere problemi complessi in passi che guidano lo sviluppo del prodotto.

Uno dei tanti motivi per cui Google porta costantemente prodotti innovativi e mutevoli sul mercato è a causa del lavoro collaborativo che facciamo in Product Management. • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience in product management, or a related technical role.

• 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in a technology or business related field.

• Experience getting things done in large matrixed organizations.

• Experience building AI native product experiences.

• Experience building enterprise and consumer facing products.

• High agency and accountability.

About the job
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Time management comprise Google Calendar and Tasks - the goal of these is to help users make the most of their time.
They are a key part of Google Workspace . Both are available on Web, Android and iOS with a robust third-party developer ecosystem.
We want to help people make time for what matters most by making it easy for users to plan time for them and their collaborators, and execute on their goals.
We see Calendar and Tasks as primitives that should be deeply integrated into everyday journeys across Workspace and Google.
Calendar and Tasks must meet the needs of varied stakeholders - from consumers through to C-suite execs, their ABPs, knowledge workers, IT admins, partners and developers.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
Responsibilities

• User and Market Insights: Partner with UX/UXR to deeply understand target personas and contexts, while analyzing productivity market landscapes and competitive dynamics.

• Product Strategy: Engage directly with customers to identify pain points, validate solutions, and translate insights into actionable product concepts.

• Technical Leadership: Inspire engineering teams to build and deploy complex software solutions, focusing on architectural modernization through Machine Learning (ML) and Large Language Models (LLMs).

• AI-First Development: Advocate an AI-centric approach by collaborating cross-functionally to define robust evaluations and measure the ongoing quality of AI-powered features.

• Execution and Visibility: Manage feature backlogs, prioritize team workloads, and act as the primary representative of the team's work to Director+ executives.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience with leading multiple design domains (Design For Test, Design Verification and Physical Design).

• 5 years of experience with logic design, computer architecture, and circuit theory.

• 5 years of experience in power or performance modeling or system performance analysis.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.

• 2 year of experience in linux kernel programming.

• Experience with processor core architectures (such as ARM, x86, RISC-V, etc.) and IPs commonly used in SoC designs.

About the job
As a part of today's hyperscale AI competition, accelerators have become a strategic differentiator. In this role, you will help deliver codesigned systems that, unlike classic data center infrastructure, must meet future demands as our workloads continue to evolve and mutate. You will deploying new hardware in Google data centers through our projects to drive enhanced capabilities and efficiency, partner closely with the teams responsible for Google’s technical infrastructure to successfully deliver these systems.

In this role, you will join a co-design team within DeepMind’s GenAI Systems, operating across Google’s vertically integrated stack. In this role, you will bring expertise spanning hardware, including architecture, logic design, design verification, and physical design software, such as compilation, performance optimization, libraries, operating systems, and kernels, and algorithms, covering ML model design, optimization methods, numerics, and sparsity. In these fields, you will conduct cutting-edge research while delivering production-quality hardware and software products.
Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer various learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $256000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Architect, design, and implement hardware for novel systolic array accelerators.

• Own subsystems up to the entire accelerator, carry the implementation of those subsystems from requirements through design sketches, implementation, timing closure, through tapeout, and into bringup and application mapping.

• Collaborate with application, algorithm, and performance-tuning experts to codesign solutions for the best efficiency, performance, and programmability.

• Write code for accelerators to meet up with production requirements at the system, library, and application levels.

• Bring a generalist approach to computer systems beyond specific hardware-related skills, interfacing with colleagues in a wide span of disciplines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Informatica, Scienza Informatica, un campo correlato, o equivalente esperienza pratica.

• 10 anni di esperienza con i principali domini di design multipli (Design For Test, Design Verification e Physical Design).

• 5 anni di esperienza con progettazione logica, architettura del computer e teoria del circuito.

• 5 anni di esperienza nella modellazione della potenza o delle prestazioni o nell'analisi delle prestazioni del sistema.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Informatica o Scienza Informatica, con un'enfasi sull'architettura del computer.

• 2 anni di esperienza nella programmazione del kernel linux.

• Esperienza con le architetture core del processore (come ARM, x86, RISC-V, ecc.) e gli IP comunemente utilizzati nei disegni SoC.

Riguardo al lavoro
Come parte della competizione AI di oggi, gli acceleratori sono diventati un differenziatore strategico. In questo ruolo, vi aiuterà a fornire sistemi codesigned che, a differenza dell'infrastruttura del data center classico, devono soddisfare le esigenze future in quanto i nostri carichi di lavoro continuano ad evolvere e mutare. Si distribuirà nuovo hardware in data center di Google attraverso i nostri progetti per guidare le funzionalità e l'efficienza migliorate, partner a stretto contatto con i team responsabili dell'infrastruttura tecnica di Google per fornire con successo questi sistemi.

In questo ruolo, si unirà a un team di co-design all'interno dei sistemi GenAI di DeepMind, che opera attraverso lo stack verticalmente integrato di Google. In questo ruolo, si porterà competenze che spaziano dall'hardware, tra cui architettura, progettazione logica, verifica del design e software di progettazione fisica, come compilazione, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, librerie, sistemi operativi, e kernel, e algoritmi, che coprono la progettazione del modello ML, metodi di ottimizzazione, numerici e sparsità. In questi campi, si effettuerà una ricerca all'avanguardia durante la fornitura di prodotti hardware e software di qualità di produzione.
L’intelligenza artificiale sarà una delle invenzioni più trasformative dell’umanità. A Google DeepMind, siamo un laboratorio AI pionieristico con team interdisciplinari eccezionali focalizzati sull'avanzamento dello sviluppo AI per risolvere complesse sfide globali e accelerare l'innovazione di prodotto di alta qualità per miliardi di utenti. Utilizziamo le nostre tecnologie per un ampio beneficio pubblico e una scoperta scientifica, assicurando la sicurezza e l'etica sono sempre la nostra massima priorità.

Stiamo spingendo i confini attraverso più domini. I nostri team globali offrono diverse opportunità di apprendimento e percorsi di carriera diversificati per coloro che sono spinti a raggiungere risultati eccezionali attraverso lo sforzo collettivo. La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti.

US: $256000 - $278000 (USD) + target bonus del 20%

Scopri di più sui vantaggi di Google .
responsabilità

• Architetto, design e implementare hardware per nuovi acceleratori di array sistolici.

• Sottosistemi propri fino all'intero acceleratore, portare l'implementazione di quei sottosistemi dai requisiti attraverso schizzi di progettazione, implementazione, chiusura dei tempi, attraverso il tapeout, e nella mappatura di presentazione e applicazione.

• Collabora con esperti di applicazione, algoritmo e performance-tuning per coprogettare soluzioni per la migliore efficienza, performance e programmabilità.

• Scrivere codice per gli acceleratori per soddisfare i requisiti di produzione ai livelli di sistema, biblioteca e applicazione.

• Portare un approccio generalista ai sistemi informatici al di là delle specifiche competenze legate all'hardware, interfacciandosi con i colleghi in una vasta gamma di discipline.

Preferred qualifications:

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
 Responsibilities

• Write product or system development code.

• Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

• Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

• Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

• Implement solutions in one or more specialized ML areas, utilize ML infrastructure, and contribute to model optimization and data processing.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 9 years of experience in technical compliance, facility management, or operations for data centers and mission-critical facilities.

• Experience with critical data center infrastructure, specifically power distribution, cooling systems, and safety protocols.

• Experience leading and fronting both internal and external compliance audits for technical facilities.

• Ability to travel up to 50% across the EMEA region to conduct site visits and audits.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience validating and executing Integrated Operational Readiness Drills (iORD) and emergency response simulations.

• Experience reviewing and verifying technical maintenance logs and documentation from third-party service providers to ensure Service Level Agreement (SLA) adherence.

• Familiarity with emerging European regulations and international operational standards relevant to data center compliance.

• Ability to develop comprehensive audit plans and use analytical dashboards to communicate risk tiers to executive management.

• Demonstrated ability to drive operational resilience, identify deficiencies in infrastructure failover, and maintain peak performance across third-party facility partnerships.

About the job
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As a master of exceptional practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a part of the Technical Operations Manager within Third-Party Data Center Operations EMEA, your mission is to ensure the highest levels of digital operational resilience, safety, and regulatory compliance across all third-party data center partnerships. You will lead comprehensive audit programs and foster cross-functional excellence with local metro Target Operating Model (TOM), Corrective Action Plan (CAP) and Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) teams safeguards the stability of the digital value chain and ensures a consistent provision of services.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
