 Responsibilities

• Act as the primary Third-Party Data Center Operations (3PDCOPs) representative for all CAP audits, coordinating with local managers to demonstrate site operational resilience.

• Develop audit plans and verify service provider evidence, like maintenance logs, to ensure critical infrastructure is properly serviced.

• Partner with the CAP team to address deficiencies, applying risk-based tools to prioritize issues, set remediation deadlines, and ensure compliance.

• Track drill outcomes and simulations (e.g., ORD/iORD) to document improvements and ensure resilience exercises are executed to standard.

• Deliver detailed reports and use analytic dashboards to communicate audit trends, site performance, and overall EMEA compliance posture to leadership.

Assicurarsi che gli standard ambientali e di sicurezza sono costantemente soddisfatti, identificare i problemi e fare riparazioni rapidamente In situazioni di emergenza o condizioni anormali, si gestisce i problemi di prestazioni del data center e outages per ridurre al minimo il tempo di recupero da guasti.

Nell'ambito del Technical Operations Manager all'interno di Third-Party Data Center Operations EMEA, la vostra missione è quella di garantire i massimi livelli di resilienza operativa digitale, sicurezza e conformità normativa in tutte le partnership del data center di terze parti. Potrai condurre programmi di audit completi e promuovere l'eccellenza interfunzionale con la metropolitana locale Target Operating Model (TOM), Corrective Action Plan (CAP) e Ambiente, Salute e Sicurezza (EHS) team salvaguarda la stabilità della catena del valore digitale e garantisce una fornitura coerente di servizi. Dietro tutto ciò che i nostri utenti vedono online è l'architettura costruita dal team di Infrastrutture Tecniche per mantenerla in funzione. Dallo sviluppo e dal mantenimento dei nostri data center per la costruzione della nuova generazione di piattaforme Google, rendiamo possibile il portafoglio prodotti di Google. Siamo orgogliosi di essere gli ingegneri dei nostri ingegneri e di avere l'amore per le garanzie di vuoto, facendo le cose a parte così possiamo ricostruirle. Teniamo le nostre reti in funzione, garantendo ai nostri utenti la migliore e più veloce esperienza possibile. • 9 years of experience in technical compliance, facility management, or operations for data centers and mission-critical facilities.

• Experience with critical data center infrastructure, specifically power distribution, cooling systems, and safety protocols.

• Experience leading and fronting both internal and external compliance audits for technical facilities.

• Ability to travel up to 50% across the EMEA region to conduct site visits and audits.

Preferred qualifications:

• Familiarity with emerging European regulations and international operational standards relevant to data center compliance.

• Ability to develop comprehensive audit plans and use analytical dashboards to communicate risk tiers to executive management.

• Demonstrated ability to drive operational resilience, identify deficiencies in infrastructure failover, and maintain peak performance across third-party facility partnerships.

About the job
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As a master of exceptional practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a part of the Technical Operations Manager within Third-Party Data Center Operations EMEA, your mission is to ensure the highest levels of digital operational resilience, safety, and regulatory compliance across all third-party data center partnerships. You will lead comprehensive audit programs and foster cross-functional excellence with local metro Target Operating Model (TOM), Corrective Action Plan (CAP) and Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) teams safeguards the stability of the digital value chain and ensures a consistent provision of services.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. Das Data Center-Team entwickelt und betreibt einige der modernsten Elektrotechnik-, Maschinenbau- und Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen (HVAC) Systeme der Welt. Facility-Techniker in Google-Rechenzentren betreiben, überwachen und unterstützen physische Anlagenbedingungen. jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in software development.

• 7 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, GO, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

• 5 years of experience with design and architecture; and testing/launching software products.

• 3 years of experience in performance analysis including large-scale distributed systems, machine learning optimization and performance optimization.

• Experience in machine learning and performance optimization.

Preferred qualifications:

• Deep understanding of performance optimization within a constrained environment.

• Familiarity with how AI-driven signals and ML models translate into retail-specific business value and user-facing improvements.

• Ability to synthesize complex datasets and various performance metrics into actionable strategic insights and clear technical roadmaps.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity and "connect the dots" across various product areas to build a cohesive, long-term vision for retail advertising.

• Ability to balance trade-offs between automated value delivery and system limitations.

• Proven track record of leading complex, multi-disciplinary projects from conception to execution, and ability to influence and align stakeholders across engineering, product, and sales.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

As we enter the age of AI transformation on search, we have a need to improve the user understanding, advertiser intent and LTV value definition to power automated value delivery for retailers.
 Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Own the technical and strategic roadmap for retail signals, goals and optimization.

• Improve the user understanding, advertiser intent and LTV value definition to power automated value delivery for retailers.

• Work with PMs and executives, identify the right areas of improvements, making sure all the areas come together. For example, how we consolidate different tools for value adjustments and use consistently across predictions and optimization.

• Work with senior cross-product area partners to leverage their expertise and infrastructure.

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del software.

• 7 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di stack completo, attraverso back-end come Java, Python, GO o C++ codebases, e l'esperienza di front-end tra cui JavaScript o TypeScript, HTML, CSS o equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza con il design e l'architettura; e test / lancio di prodotti software.

• 3 anni di esperienza nell'analisi delle prestazioni tra cui sistemi distribuiti su larga scala, ottimizzazione dell'apprendimento automatico e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni.

• Esperienza nell'apprendimento automatico e nell'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Profonda comprensione dell'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni all'interno di un ambiente limitato.

• La familiarità con come i segnali AI-driven e i modelli ML si traducono in valore aziendale specifico al dettaglio e miglioramenti rispetto agli utenti.

• Capacità di sintetizzare set di dati complessi e varie metriche di performance in insight strategici attuabili e chiare roadmap tecniche.

• Capacità di navigare ambiguità e "collegare i punti" in varie aree di prodotto per costruire una visione coesa e a lungo termine per la pubblicità al dettaglio.

• Capacità di bilanciare i trade-off tra la distribuzione automatizzata del valore e i limiti del sistema.

• Rilevato record di importanti progetti complessi e multidisciplinari dal concepimento all'esecuzione, e la capacità di influenzare e allineare le parti interessate attraverso l'ingegneria, il prodotto e le vendite.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Con la tua esperienza tecnica gestirai le priorità del progetto, le scadenze e i risultati. Potrai progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni software.

Entrando nell'era della trasformazione AI nella ricerca, abbiamo la necessità di migliorare la comprensione dell'utente, l'intento dell'inserzionista e la definizione del valore LTV per alimentare la consegna automatica dei valori per i rivenditori.
Google Google Ads sta aiutando il potere Internet aperto con la migliore tecnologia che collega e crea valore per le persone, editori, inserzionisti, e Google. Siamo costituiti da più team, la costruzione di prodotti pubblicitari di Google, tra cui ricerca, display, shopping, viaggi e pubblicità video, nonché analisi. I nostri team creano esperienze fidate tra persone e aziende con annunci utili. Aiutiamo a crescere le aziende di tutte le dimensioni da piccole imprese, a grandi marchi, ai creatori di YouTube, con efficaci strumenti di inserzionista che forniscono risultati misurabili. Permettiamo anche a Google di interagire con i clienti in scala.

• Lavorare con PM e dirigenti, identificare le giuste aree di miglioramento, assicurandosi che tutte le aree si uniscano. Ad esempio, come consolidare diversi strumenti per la regolazione del valore e utilizzare costantemente attraverso previsioni e ottimizzazione.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in software development.

• 7 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, GO, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

• 5 years of experience with design and architecture; and testing/launching software products.

• 3 years of experience in performance analysis including large-scale distributed systems, machine learning optimization and performance optimization.

• Experience in machine learning and performance optimization.

Preferred qualifications:

• Deep understanding of performance optimization within a constrained environment.

• Familiarity with how AI-driven signals and ML models translate into retail-specific business value and user-facing improvements.

• Ability to synthesize complex datasets and various performance metrics into actionable strategic insights and clear technical roadmaps.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity and "connect the dots" across various product areas to build a cohesive, long-term vision for retail advertising.

• Ability to balance trade-offs between automated value delivery and system limitations.

• Proven track record of leading complex, multi-disciplinary projects from conception to execution, and ability to influence and align stakeholders across engineering, product, and sales.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

As we enter the age of AI transformation on search, we have a need to improve the user understanding, advertiser intent and LTV value definition to power automated value delivery for retailers.
Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
Responsibilities

• Own the technical and strategic roadmap for retail signals, goals and optimization.

• Improve the user understanding, advertiser intent and LTV value definition to power automated value delivery for retailers.

• Work with PMs and executives, identify the right areas of improvements, making sure all the areas come together. For example, how we consolidate different tools for value adjustments and use consistently across predictions and optimization.

• Work with senior cross-product area partners to leverage their expertise and infrastructure.

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience building software for data privacy or security (e.g., identity and access management).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience of working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Experience building security tooling.

• Experience in static analysis or dynamic analysis.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

• Write product or system development code.

• Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

• Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

• Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

• Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato.

• 2 anni di software per la costruzione di esperienze per la privacy o la sicurezza dei dati (ad esempio, l'identità e la gestione degli accessi).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici correlati.

• 2 anni di esperienza di lavoro in un complesso, matrice organizzazione che coinvolge progetti interfunzionali o cross-business.

• 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

• Esperienza costruzione strumenti di sicurezza.

• Esperienza nell'analisi statica o nell'analisi dinamica.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

In questo ruolo, con le tue competenze tecniche gestirai priorità di progetto, scadenze e consegnabili. Potrai progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni software.

Google Cloud accelera la capacità di ogni organizzazione di trasformare digitalmente il suo business e l'industria. Offriamo soluzioni di livello enterprise che sfruttano la tecnologia all'avanguardia di Google e gli strumenti che aiutano gli sviluppatori a costruire in modo più sostenibile. I clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori si rivolgono a Google Cloud come partner affidabile per consentire la crescita e risolvere i loro problemi aziendali più critici.

responsabilità

• Scrivere il codice di sviluppo del prodotto o del sistema.

• Partecipa a, o guida recensioni di design con colleghi e stakeholder per decidere tra le tecnologie disponibili.

• Codice di revisione sviluppato da altri sviluppatori e fornire feedback per garantire le migliori pratiche (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, controllo del codice, accuratezza, testabilità e efficienza).

• Contribuisci alla documentazione esistente o ai contenuti educativi e adatta i contenuti in base agli aggiornamenti del prodotto/programma e al feedback degli utenti.

• Triage prodotto o problemi di sistema e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete, o operazioni di servizio e qualità.

Titres préférés:

• 2 ans d'expérience de travail dans une organisation complexe et matricielle impliquant des projets interfonctionnels ou interprofessionnels.

• 2 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

• Expérience du développement de technologies accessibles.

• Expérimentez l'outillage de sécurité du bâtiment.

• Expérience en analyse statique ou en analyse dynamique.

Sur le travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Dans ce rôle, grâce à votre expertise technique, vous gérerez les priorités du projet, les échéances et les produits livrables. Vous allez concevoir, développer, tester, déployer, maintenir et améliorer des solutions logicielles.

Google Cloud accélère la capacité de chaque organisation à transformer numériquement ses affaires et son industrie. Nous fournissons des solutions de qualité entreprise qui tirent parti de la technologie de pointe de Google, et des outils qui aident les développeurs à construire plus durablement. Les clients de plus de 200 pays et territoires se tournent vers Google Cloud en tant que partenaire de confiance pour favoriser la croissance et résoudre leurs problèmes commerciaux les plus critiques.

• Participer ou diriger des examens de conception avec des pairs et des intervenants pour décider entre les technologies disponibles.

• Trier les problèmes de produit ou de système et déboguer, suivre et résoudre en analysant les sources de problèmes et l'impact sur le matériel, le réseau ou les opérations de service et la qualité.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer-facing role.

• Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.

• Experience leading technical discovery sessions.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).

• Experience identifying business problems and translating complex hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and technical teams.

• Experience influencing and driving outcomes with cross-functional teams on engagements of high complexity and large scope and scale.

• Experience performing discovery interviews to identify business problems and translate hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and technical teams.

• Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

About the job
As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. Your role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset as you will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll leverage Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
 Responsibilities

• Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol. (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).

• Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.

• Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

• Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

• Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

• Provate a prendere soluzioni AI-driven di qualità produttiva dal concepimento al lancio e all'archiviazione di sistemi AI su piattaforme cloud (ad esempio, Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Condutture di edifici per dati strutturati e non strutturati utilizzando sia database vettoriali che architetture Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-like per le soluzioni AI enterprise.

• Esperienza di sessioni di scoperta tecnica leader.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Master o PhD in AI, Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.

• Esperienza nell'implementazione di sistemi multi-agenti utilizzando quadri (ad esempio, LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) e modelli complessi (ad esempio, ReAct, auto-riflessione, delegazione gerarchica).

• Scopri i problemi aziendali e traduce complessi vincoli hardware/AI per C-suites e team tecnici.

• Esperienza che influenza e guida i risultati con team interfunzionali su impegni di alta complessità e ampia portata e scala.

• Sperimenta le interviste alla scoperta per identificare i problemi aziendali e tradurre vincoli hardware/AI per C-suites e team tecnici.

• Conoscenza delle metriche "LLM-native" (ad esempio, token/sec, costo-per-richiesta) e tecniche per ottimizzare la gestione dello stato e il tracciamento granulare.

Riguardo al lavoro
In qualità di GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) presso Google Cloud, sei un costruttore integrato che colma il divario tra i prodotti AI di frontiera e la realtà di produzione all'interno dei clienti. A differenza dei tradizionali ruoli di consulenza, si lavora come "innovatore-costruttore", andando oltre l'architettura di alto livello per codificare, debug, e congiuntamente spedire soluzioni agentic su misura direttamente all'interno dell'ambiente del cliente. Il vostro ruolo è progettato per gli ingegneri ad alta agenza con la mentalità di un fondatore, come si rivolgerà ai bloccanti alla produzione, tra cui risolvere le complessità di integrazione, problemi di disponibilità di dati, e le sfide di gestione dello stato che impediscono l'IA di raggiungere la maturità di livello enterprise. Con l'integrazione di account strategici, si serve di un duplice scopo: fornire la distribuzione "bianco guanto" di sistemi AI complessi e agire come un loop di feedback critico, trasformando le intuizioni sul campo reale nel futuro prodotto roadmap di Google Cloud. E 'un momento emozionante per unire il team Go-To-Market di Google Cloud, leader la rivoluzione AI per le aziende in tutto il mondo. Leverai la credibilità del marchio di Google, un'eredità costruita sull'invenzione delle tecnologie di base e provata su scala. Vi forniremo il portafoglio AI più avanzato al mondo, compresi i modelli di frontiera Gemini, e la piattaforma completa Vertex AI, aiutandovi a risolvere i problemi aziendali. Siamo una cultura collaborativa che offre accesso diretto alle menti ingegneristiche e di ricerca di DeepMind, consentendoti di risolvere le sfide dei clienti. Unisciti a noi per essere il catalizzatore per la nostra missione, guidare il successo del cliente e definire la nuova era cloud - il mercato è tuo.
responsabilità

• Serve come sviluppatore per applicazioni AI complesse, passando dai prototipi rapidi ai flussi di lavoro agentici di livello produttivo (ad esempio, sistemi multi-agenti, server di Model Context Protocol. (MCP) che guidano il ritorno misurabile sugli investimenti (ROI).

• Architetto e codifica il "tessuto connettivo" tra i prodotti AI di Google e l'infrastruttura live del cliente, tra cui API, data silos legacy e perimetro di sicurezza come parte di un team esperto.

• Costruire condotte di valutazione ad alte prestazioni e quadri di osservabilità per garantire che i sistemi agentici soddisfino requisiti rigorosi per l'accuratezza, la sicurezza e la latenza.

• Identificare modelli di campo ripetibili e punti di attrito nello stack AI di Google, convertirli in moduli riutilizzabili o richieste formali di funzionalità di prodotto per i team di Engineering.

• Co-costruire con i team di ingegneria dei clienti per instillare le migliori pratiche di sviluppo di Google-grade, garantendo il successo del progetto a lungo termine e l'adozione dell'utente finale.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Cloud Computing oder in einer technischen Kundenrolle.

• Erfahrung mit KI-gesteuerten Lösungen in Produktionsqualität von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Architektur von KI-Systemen auf Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. Google Cloud Platform, GCP).

• Erleben Sie Pipelines für strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten, die sowohl Vektordatenbanken als auch RAG-ähnliche Architekturen (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) verwenden, um KI-Lösungen für Unternehmen zu unterstützen.

• Erleben Sie führende technische Entdeckungssitzungen.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master oder PhD in AI, Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

• Erfahrung in der Implementierung von Multiagentensystemen mit Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) und komplexen Mustern (z. B. ReAct, Selbstreflexion, hierarchische Delegation).

• Erfahrung in der Identifizierung von Geschäftsproblemen und der Übersetzung komplexer Hardware-/KI-Einschränkungen für C-Suiten und technische Teams.

• Erleben Sie, wie Sie Ergebnisse mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams bei Engagements von hoher Komplexität und großem Umfang und Umfang beeinflussen und vorantreiben.

• Führen Sie Discovery-Interviews durch, um Geschäftsprobleme zu identifizieren und Hardware-/KI-Einschränkungen für C-Suiten und technische Teams zu übersetzen.

• Kenntnis von "LLM-nativen" Metriken (z. B. Token/Sec, Cost-per-Request) und Techniken zur Optimierung des Zustandsmanagements und des granularen Tracing.

Über den Job
Als GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) bei Google Cloud sind Sie ein Embedded Builder, der die Lücke zwischen bahnbrechenden KI-Produkten und der Realität in der Produktion innerhalb der Kunden schließt. Im Gegensatz zu herkömmlichen Beratungsrollen fungieren Sie als "Innovator-Builder" und gehen über die High-Level-Architektur hinaus, um maßgeschneiderte agentische Lösungen direkt in der Kundenumgebung zu kodieren, zu debuggen und gemeinsam zu versenden. Ihre Rolle richtet sich an hochrangige Ingenieure mit der Denkweise eines Gründers, da Sie sich mit Blockern für die Produktion befassen, einschließlich der Lösung der Integrationskomplexitäten, Datenbereitschaftsprobleme und Herausforderungen des Staatsmanagements, die verhindern, dass KI die Reife erreicht. Durch die Einbettung in strategische Konten erfüllen Sie einen doppelten Zweck: Die Bereitstellung von komplexen KI-Systemen mit "weißem Handschuh" und als kritische Feedbackschleife, die reale Einblicke in die zukünftige Produkt-Roadmap von Google Cloud umwandelt. Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, dem Go-To-Market-Team von Google Cloud beizutreten, das die KI-Revolution für Unternehmen weltweit anführt. Sie werden die Glaubwürdigkeit der Marke von Google nutzen - ein Vermächtnis, das auf der Erfindung grundlegender Technologien basiert und sich in großem Maßstab bewährt hat. Wir bieten Ihnen das weltweit fortschrittlichste KI-Portfolio, einschließlich Frontier Gemini-Modelle, und die komplette Vertex AI-Plattform, die Ihnen hilft, Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen. Wir sind eine kollaborative Kultur, die direkten Zugang zu DeepMinds Engineering- und Forschungsteams bietet und Sie in die Lage versetzt, Kundenherausforderungen zu lösen. Seien Sie mit uns der Katalysator für unsere Mission, treiben Sie den Kundenerfolg voran und definieren Sie die neue Cloud-Ära – der Markt gehört Ihnen.
Zuständigkeiten

• Dienen Sie als Entwickler für komplexe KI-Anwendungen und wechseln Sie von schnellen Prototypen zu agentischen Workflows in Produktionsqualität (z. B. Multiagentensysteme, Model Context Protocol. (MCP) Server), die einen messbaren Return on Investment (ROI) erzielen.

• Erstellen und codieren Sie das "Verbindungsgewebe" zwischen den KI-Produkten von Google und der Live-Infrastruktur des Kunden, einschließlich APIs, Legacy-Datensilos und Sicherheitsperimetern als Teil eines Expertenteams.

• Erstellen Sie leistungsstarke Bewertungspipelines und Beobachtbarkeits-Frameworks, um sicherzustellen, dass Agentensysteme strenge Anforderungen an Genauigkeit, Sicherheit und Latenz erfüllen.

• Identifizieren Sie wiederholbare Feldmuster und Reibungspunkte im KI-Stack von Google und konvertieren Sie sie in wiederverwendbare Module oder formelle Produktfunktionsanforderungen für die Engineering-Teams.

• Co-Build mit Kunden-Engineering-Teams, um Best Practices für die Entwicklung von Google zu entwickeln und so langfristigen Projekterfolg und eine hohe Akzeptanz durch den Endbenutzer zu gewährleisten.

• Expérimentez l'utilisation de solutions basées sur l'intelligence artificielle de qualité de production, de la conception au lancement et à l'architecture de systèmes d'intelligence artificielle sur des plateformes cloud (p. ex. Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Expérimentez la construction de pipelines pour des données structurées et non structurées utilisant à la fois des bases de données vectorielles et des architectures de type Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pour alimenter les solutions AI d'entreprise.

• Expérience des séances de découverte technique.

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en intelligence artificielle, informatique ou domaine technique connexe.

• Expérience de la mise en oeuvre de systèmes multi-agents utilisant des cadres (p. ex. LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) et des modèles complexes (p. ex. ReAct, autoréflexion, délégation hiérarchique).

Sur le travail

Contrairement aux rôles consultatifs traditionnels, vous agissez comme un « innovateur-constructeur », allant au-delà de l'architecture de haut niveau pour coder, déboguer et expédier conjointement des solutions agentiques sur mesure directement dans l'environnement du client. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre l'équipe Go-To-Market de Google Cloud, qui mène la révolution de l'IA pour les entreprises du monde entier. Vous allez tirer parti de la crédibilité de la marque de Google – un héritage fondé sur l'invention de technologies fondamentales et prouvé à l'échelle. Nous vous fournissons le portefeuille AI le plus avancé au monde, y compris les modèles frontière Gemini, et la plateforme Altex AI complète, vous aidant à résoudre des problèmes d'affaires. Nous sommes une culture collaborative offrant un accès direct aux esprits d'ingénierie et de recherche de DeepMind, vous permettant de résoudre les défis des clients. Rejoignez-nous pour être le catalyseur de notre mission, stimuler le succès client et définir la nouvelle ère du cloud – le marché est à vous.

• Bâtir des pipelines d'évaluation de haute performance et des cadres d'observation pour s'assurer que les systèmes d'agents répondent à des exigences rigoureuses en matière de précision, de sécurité et de latence.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of sales experience in the technology industry with SaaS, PaaS or IaaS products and platforms.

• Experience engaging with accounts, selling a portfolio of products at C-level.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience selling Cloud Solutions, Infrastructure Software, Databases, Analytic Tools, or Applications Software across multiple industries, aligning solutions to drive business outcomes.

• Experience working with, and leading, cross-functional teams and partners in implementations and negotiations.

• Experience with commercial and legal negotiations, working with Procurement, Legal, and Business teams.

• Experience working with Customer Engineers and customers' technical leads to inventory software estate, define migration plans, and build migration business cases.

• Ability to communicate in English and German or French languages fluently to interact with the clients.

• Passion for building Greenfield territories, acquiring new logos and securing foundational workload(s) to accelerate consumption revenue.

About the job
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

In this role you will manage Google Cloud's relationship with some of the largest enterprise companies and grow Google Cloud's footprint with these accounts.

You will be responsible for setting the overall account strategy and working effectively with numerous cross-functional partners and sales specialists to execute against this strategy.

You will lead the engagement with a group of cross-industry enterprise customers and assist them in solving their business challenges with our solutions. Your success will rely upon your ability to identify specific business problems working with stakeholders across your accounts, and partnering with your extended team to develop technical solutions to solve them. Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 10 Jahre Verkaufserfahrung in der Technologiebranche mit SaaS, PaaS oder IaaS Produkten und Plattformen.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Konten, Verkauf eines Portfolios von Produkten auf C-Level.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Erleben Sie den Verkauf von Cloud-Lösungen, Infrastruktursoftware, Datenbanken, Analysetools oder Anwendungssoftware in verschiedenen Branchen und richten Sie Lösungen so aus, dass sie die Geschäftsergebnisse steigern.

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit und der Leitung von funktionsübergreifenden Teams und Partnern in Implementierungen und Verhandlungen.

• Erfahrung mit kommerziellen und rechtlichen Verhandlungen, Zusammenarbeit mit Beschaffungs-, Rechts- und Geschäftsteams.

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Customer Engineers und den technischen Kunden führt zu Inventarsoftware, Definition von Migrationsplänen und Erstellung von Migrationsgeschäftsfällen.

• Fähigkeit, fließend auf Englisch und Deutsch oder Französisch zu kommunizieren, um mit den Kunden zu interagieren.

• Leidenschaft für den Aufbau von Greenfield-Territorien, den Erwerb neuer Logos und die Sicherung grundlegender Arbeitslasten, um die Konsumeinnahmen zu beschleunigen.

Über den Job
Das Google Cloud Platform-Team hilft Kunden, das zu transformieren und zu bauen, was für ihr Unternehmen als nächstes kommt - alles mit der in der Cloud integrierten Technologie. Unsere Produkte sind auf Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Skalierbarkeit ausgerichtet und führen den gesamten Stapel von der Infrastruktur über Anwendungen bis hin zu Geräten und Hardware aus. Unsere Teams unterstützen unsere Kunden - Entwickler, kleine und große Unternehmen, Bildungseinrichtungen und Regierungsbehörden - dabei, die Vorteile unserer Technologie zum Leben zu erwecken. Als Teil eines unternehmerischen Teams in diesem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle beim Verständnis der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und helfen, die Zukunft von Unternehmen jeder Größe mithilfe von Technologie mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Partnern zu verbinden.

In dieser Rolle verwalten Sie die Beziehung von Google Cloud zu einigen der größten Unternehmen und vergrößern die Präsenz von Google Cloud mit diesen Konten.

Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, die Gesamtkontostrategie festzulegen und effektiv mit zahlreichen funktionsübergreifenden Partnern und Vertriebsspezialisten zusammenzuarbeiten, um diese Strategie umzusetzen.

Sie führen das Engagement mit einer Gruppe branchenübergreifender Unternehmenskunden und unterstützen sie bei der Lösung ihrer geschäftlichen Herausforderungen mit unseren Lösungen. Ihr Erfolg hängt von Ihrer Fähigkeit ab, spezifische Geschäftsprobleme zu identifizieren, mit Stakeholdern in Ihren Konten zu arbeiten und mit Ihrem erweiterten Team zusammenzuarbeiten, um technische Lösungen zu entwickeln. Sie sind verantwortlich für den Aufbau sinnvoller Beziehungen auf verschiedenen Ebenen innerhalb des Kunden, von Entwicklern bis hin zu Führungskräften der C-Suite.
Google Cloud beschleunigt die Fähigkeit jedes Unternehmens, sein Geschäft und seine Branche digital zu verändern. Wir liefern Lösungen für Unternehmen, die die modernste Technologie von Google nutzen, und Tools, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre wichtigsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen. Die individuelle Bezahlung wird durch Faktoren wie berufsbezogene Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und relevante Bildung oder Ausbildung bestimmt.

Deutschland: €100000 - €102000 (EUR) + 150% Bonusziel + Eigenkapital + Vorteile

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Vorteile bei Google.
Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie die Prospektion und Übernahme von Nettoneugeschäften, erstellen und bauen Sie Kundenbeziehungen von Grund auf neu auf und etablieren Sie sich als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für ihre langfristigen Technologie- und Geschäftsentscheidungen.

• Werden Sie Experte für das Geschäft der Kunden, einschließlich ihres SaaS-Produktportfolios, ihrer Technologiestrategie, ihrer strategischen Wachstumspläne, ihrer Geschäftstreiber, ihrer Finanzstruktur, ihrer Kundenbasis, ihres vertikalen Marktangebots und ihrer Wettbewerbslandschaft.

• Lead-Account-Strategie zur Entwicklung von Geschäftswachstumsmöglichkeiten, die funktionsübergreifend mit mehreren Teams und Google-Partnern zusammenarbeiten, um die Geschäftswirkung bei Unternehmenskunden zu maximieren.

• Verwalten Sie komplexe Verkaufszyklen, präsentieren Sie Führungskräften auf C-Level und verhandeln Sie über Bedingungen.

• Fördern Sie die Geschäftsentwicklung, eigene operative Exzellenz in großem Maßstab, prognostizieren Sie genau und erreichen Sie strategische Ziele, indem Sie Kunden durch den gesamten Geschäftszyklus führen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 10 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie de la technologie avec les produits et plateformes SaaS, PaaS ou IaaS.

• Expérience en matière de comptabilité, vente d'un portefeuille de produits au niveau C.

Titres préférés:

• Découvrez la vente de solutions Cloud, de logiciels d'infrastructure, de bases de données, d'outils analytiques ou de logiciels d'applications dans plusieurs industries, en alignant les solutions pour générer des résultats commerciaux.

• Expérience de travail avec des équipes et des partenaires interfonctionnels et à la tête de ces équipes dans la mise en oeuvre et les négociations.

• Expérience des négociations commerciales et juridiques, en collaboration avec les équipes d'approvisionnement, juridiques et commerciales.

• Expérience de travail avec les ingénieurs clients et les pistes techniques des clients à l'inventaire des logiciels, définir des plans de migration, et construire des affaires de migration.

• Capacité de communiquer en anglais et en allemand ou en français couramment pour interagir avec les clients.

• Passionné de construire des territoires de Greenfield, acquisition de nouveaux logos et sécurisation de la charge de travail fondamentale pour accélérer les recettes de consommation.

Sur le travail
L'équipe de Google Cloud Platform aide les clients à transformer et à construire ce qui suit pour leur entreprise, le tout avec une technologie intégrée dans le cloud. Nos produits sont développés pour la sécurité, la fiabilité et l'évolutivité, en exécutant la pile complète de l'infrastructure aux applications aux appareils et au matériel. Nos équipes se consacrent à aider nos clients — les promoteurs, les petites et grandes entreprises, les établissements d'enseignement et les organismes gouvernementaux — à voir les avantages de notre technologie prendre vie. Dans le cadre d'une équipe entrepreneuriale dans cette entreprise en croissance rapide, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la compréhension des besoins de nos clients et aider à façonner l'avenir des entreprises de toutes tailles utilisent la technologie pour se connecter avec les clients, les employés et les partenaires.

Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez la relation de Google Cloud avec certaines des plus grandes entreprises et développerez l'empreinte de Google Cloud avec ces comptes.

Vous serez chargé de définir la stratégie globale du compte et de travailler efficacement avec de nombreux partenaires et spécialistes de la vente interfonctionnels pour exécuter cette stratégie.

Vous dirigerez l'engagement auprès d'un groupe de clients d'entreprises interindustrielles et les aiderez à résoudre leurs défis commerciaux avec nos solutions. Votre succès dépendra de votre capacité à identifier des problèmes d'affaires spécifiques en collaboration avec les intervenants de vos comptes et à établir des partenariats avec votre équipe élargie pour élaborer des solutions techniques pour les résoudre. Vous serez responsable de l'établissement de relations significatives à différents niveaux au sein du client, des développeurs aux cadres C-suite.
Google Cloud accélère la capacité de chaque organisation à transformer numériquement ses affaires et son industrie. Nous fournissons des solutions de qualité entreprise qui tirent parti de la technologie de pointe de Google, et des outils qui aident les développeurs à construire plus durablement. Les clients de plus de 200 pays et territoires se tournent vers Google Cloud en tant que partenaire de confiance pour favoriser la croissance et résoudre leurs problèmes commerciaux les plus critiques. La rémunération individuelle est déterminée par des facteurs tels que les compétences professionnelles, l'expérience et les études ou la formation pertinentes.

Allemagne: 100000 € - 102000 € (EUR) + 150% de bonus + capitaux propres + avantages

En savoir plus sur les avantages chez Google .
Responsabilités

• Diriger la prospection et l'acquisition de nouvelles entreprises nettes, créer et établir des relations avec la clientèle à partir de zéro, et vous établir comme un conseiller de confiance sur leurs décisions technologiques et commerciales à long terme.

• Devenez un expert des affaires des clients, y compris leur portefeuille de produits SaaS, leur stratégie technologique, leurs plans de croissance stratégique, leurs moteurs d'affaires, leur structure financière, leur clientèle, leur offre de marché vertical et leur paysage concurrentiel.

• Diriger la stratégie de compte pour développer des opportunités de croissance d'entreprise, en travaillant de manière interfonctionnelle avec plusieurs équipes et Google Partners, afin de maximiser l'impact commercial au sein des clients d'entreprise.

• Gérer les cycles de vente complexes, présenter aux dirigeants de niveau C et les termes de négociation.

• Favoriser le développement des entreprises, leur propre excellence opérationnelle à l'échelle, prévoir avec précision et atteindre des objectifs stratégiques en dirigeant les clients tout au long du cycle économique.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of sales experience in the technology industry with SaaS, PaaS or IaaS products and platforms.

• 10 years of experience closing enterprise cloud or technology agreements with Tier-1 financial institutions or enterprise customers in other industries.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with large, complex commercial and legal negotiations working with procurement, legal, and business teams.

• Experience promoting Google Cloud computing technologies to large and complex organizations across geographies.

• Experience with Cloud transformation, navigating complex organizational change, data residency, and risk governance.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and import and export talent and ideas to achieve a broader organizational goal.

• Proven track record engaging C-suite executives (COO, CIO, Chief Architect) across the Swiss Financial Services industry.

• Demonstrated success leading multi-year cloud migrations and driving enterprise AI and data adoption strategies.

About the job
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

In this role, your mission is to help reimagine banking across Austria, Germany, and Switzerland. You will partner with leading financial institutions to solve their critical challenges, from modernizing core infrastructure to deploying AI at scale. You will combine deep industry expertise with the best of Google Cloud and Alphabet, and bring thinking and technical innovation to DACH banking. You will challenge assumptions and turn bold ideas into measurable impact for customers, clients, and Google.

Our ambition is to shape the next-generation of financial services and make Google the partner banks trust to build what’s next.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain relationships with senior bank executives to understand their business priorities.

• Lead teams of technical and business specialists to design, negotiate, and execute large technology agreements.

• Develop strategies to expand cloud adoption across core banking operations.

• Guide customers on adopting artificial intelligence, data analytics, and modern software platforms.

• Partner with internal teams and external providers to ensure secure, compliant project delivery.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience in software development.

• 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.

• Experience in C++, Java and TypeScript.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

• 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Passionate about frontend and making user experience delightful.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Responsibilities

• Write and test product or system development code.

• Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

• Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

• Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

• Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

• 3 anni di esperienza di test, manutenzione, o lancio di prodotti software.

• Esperienza in C++, Java e TypeScript.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o in campo tecnico correlato.

• 5 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• 1 anno di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

• Appassionato su frontend e facendo esperienza dell'utente deliziosa.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Su YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo è un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo la comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo comune per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e divertiamo — e lo facciamo tutti insieme.

responsabilità

• Partecipa a, o guida recensioni di design con colleghi e stakeholder per decidere tra le tecnologie disponibili.

• Codice di revisione sviluppato da altri sviluppatori e fornire feedback per garantire le migliori pratiche (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, controllo del codice, accuratezza, testabilità e efficienza).

• Contribuisci alla documentazione esistente o ai contenuti educativi e adatta i contenuti in base agli aggiornamenti del prodotto/programma e al feedback degli utenti.

• Triage prodotto o problemi di sistema e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete, o operazioni di servizio e qualità.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und eine Gemeinschaft aufbauen. Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Kraft zu geben, seine Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was er liebt, und sich dabei miteinander zu verbinden. An der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und grenzenloser Kreativität bewegen wir uns mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß - und das alles zusammen.

• Schreiben und Testen von Produkt- oder Systementwicklungscode.

• Tragen Sie zu vorhandenen Dokumentationen oder Bildungsinhalten bei und passen Sie Inhalte basierend auf Produkt- / Programmaktualisierungen und Benutzerfeedback an.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 5 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels.

• 3 ans d'expérience en test, maintenance ou lancement de produits logiciels.

• Expérience en C++, Java et TypeScript.

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou domaine technique connexe.

• 5 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

• 1 an d'expérience dans un rôle de leadership technique.

• Expérience du développement de technologies accessibles.

• Passionné de frontend et de rendre l'expérience utilisateur délicieuse.

Sur le travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Sur YouTube, nous croyons que tout le monde mérite d'avoir une voix, et que le monde est un meilleur endroit quand nous écoutons, partageons et construisons la communauté à travers nos histoires. Nous travaillons ensemble pour donner à chacun le pouvoir de partager son histoire, d'explorer ce qu'il aime et de se connecter dans le processus. Travaillant à l'intersection d'une technologie de pointe et d'une créativité illimitée, nous agissons à la vitesse de la culture avec un objectif commun de montrer aux gens le monde. Nous explorons de nouvelles idées, résolvons de vrais problèmes et nous nous amusons — et nous le faisons tous ensemble.

Responsabilités

• Écrire et tester le code de développement du produit ou du système.

• Participer ou diriger des examens de conception avec des pairs et des intervenants pour décider entre les technologies disponibles.

• Examiner le code élaboré par d'autres développeurs et fournir des commentaires pour s'assurer des pratiques exemplaires (p. ex., lignes directrices sur le style, code de vérification, exactitude, testabilité et efficacité).

• Contribuer à la documentation ou au contenu éducatif existants et adapter le contenu en fonction des mises à jour des produits/programmes et de la rétroaction des utilisateurs.

• Trier les problèmes de produit ou de système et déboguer, suivre et résoudre en analysant les sources de problèmes et l'impact sur le matériel, le réseau ou les opérations de service et la qualité.

Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und enthusiastisch zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Wir schaffen die interoperable Compute-Infrastruktur und Cloud-Plattform, die es Googlern ermöglicht, schnell und am Rande der Technologie zu bauen, ohne die Infrastruktur verwalten zu müssen.
Unser Stack ist ein wichtiges Stück Infrastruktur für die aufstrebenden KI-Plattformen und den Weg aus der Tech-Insel!

Diese Ebene wird dann als Schlüssel zum Überschreiten der Hybridgrenze verwendet. Google Cloud beschleunigt die Fähigkeit jedes Unternehmens, sein Geschäft und seine Branche digital zu verändern. Wir liefern Lösungen für Unternehmen, die die modernste Technologie von Google nutzen, und Tools, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre wichtigsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen. jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• 5 years of work experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 3 years of work experience with a PhD degree.

• Experience applying advanced statistical methods (e.g., causal inference, forecasting, predictive modeling, experimental design) to real-world business problems.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience operating with high autonomy, identifying project roadmaps, and mentoring junior team members.

• Familiarity with creator economies, subscription business models, pricing strategy, or two-sided marketplaces.

• Demonstrated track record of cross-functional leadership and driving product direction through data science in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to manage ambiguity and translate open-ended business problems into rigorous, mathematically formulated quantitative frameworks.

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex statistical concepts to non-technical stakeholders (Product Managers, Engineering Leaders, Business Strategy teams).

About the job
In this role, you will join the Creator Data Science team, whose focus is to understand the growth and behavior of YouTube's various creator ecosystem, from large traditional media companies to individual creators who are just "getting started" and to build the tools, systems, and policies that help them grow. You will collaborate across the Creator organization and format teams (e.g., Shorts, Live) to build a holistic understanding of the creator ecosystem and monetization.

Responsibilities

• Partner closely with engineering, product, and data science peers to reach ambitious Channel Membership growth targets, developing complex statistical models for pricing optimization, subscriber lifetime value, churn prediction to drive business growth.

• Collaborate with data science peers to go beyond standard metrics, leading quantitative research into user and creator behavior to uncover structural opportunities for the Channel Memberships ecosystem, supporting launch recommendations through advanced experimental design and causal inference analysis.

• Translate technical data problems into clear business recommendations, presenting findings to multiple levels of stakeholders through intuitive visual displays of quantitative information.

• Leverage custom data infrastructure or existing data models, using specialized knowledge to design and evaluate models to mathematically solve defined problems with limited precedent.

• Gather information, business goals, priorities, and organizational context around the questions to answer, and existing and upcoming data infrastructure.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Laurea magistrale in Statistica, Scienza dei dati, Matematica, Fisica, Economia, Ricerca Operativa, Ingegneria, o un campo quantitativo relativo.

• 5 anni di esperienza lavorativa utilizzando analisi per risolvere problemi di prodotto o di business, codifica (ad esempio, Python, R, SQL), querying database o analisi statistica, o 3 anni di esperienza di lavoro con un dottorato di ricerca.

• Esperienza di applicazione di metodi statistici avanzati (ad esempio, inferenza causale, previsione, modellistica predittiva, progettazione sperimentale) a problemi di business del mondo reale.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Esperienza operativa con alta autonomia, identificazione roadmap di progetto e mentoring membri del team junior.

• Familiarità con le economie dei creatori, i modelli aziendali di abbonamento, la strategia dei prezzi, o i mercati a due facce.

• Demonstrated track record di leadership interfunzionale e la guida della direzione del prodotto attraverso la scienza dei dati in un ambiente veloce.

• Capacità di gestire l'ambiguità e di tradurre i problemi di business di fascia aperta in rigorosi e matematicamente formulati framework quantitativi.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e storytelling, con la capacità di spiegare concetti statistici complessi agli stakeholder non tecnici (Product Manager, Engineering Leaders, Business Strategy team).

Riguardo al lavoro
In questo ruolo, si unirà al team Creator Data Science, il cui obiettivo è quello di comprendere la crescita e il comportamento del vari ecosistema creatore di YouTube, dalle grandi aziende di media tradizionali ai singoli creatori che sono semplicemente "iniziati" e di costruire gli strumenti, i sistemi e le politiche che li aiutano a crescere. Potrai collaborare attraverso l'organizzazione del Creatore e formato team (ad esempio, Shorts, Live) per costruire una comprensione olistica dell'ecosistema creatore e monetizzazione.

responsabilità

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i colleghi di ingegneria, prodotto e scienza dei dati per raggiungere obiettivi di crescita di Channel Membership ambiziosi, sviluppare modelli statistici complessi per l'ottimizzazione dei prezzi, abbonati valore a vita, churn predizione per guidare la crescita aziendale.

• Collabora con i coetanei della scienza dei dati per andare oltre le metriche standard, portando la ricerca quantitativa sul comportamento degli utenti e dei creatori per scoprire le opportunità strutturali per l'ecosistema delle Memberships del canale, sostenendo raccomandazioni di lancio attraverso il design sperimentale avanzato e l'analisi dell'inferenza causale.

• Tradurre i problemi tecnici dei dati in chiare raccomandazioni aziendali, presentando i risultati a più livelli di stakeholder attraverso display visivi intuitivi di informazioni quantitative.

• Leva l'infrastruttura dati personalizzata o i modelli di dati esistenti, utilizzando conoscenze specialistiche per progettare e valutare i modelli per risolvere matematicamente i problemi definiti con un precedente limitato.

• Raccogli informazioni, obiettivi aziendali, priorità e contesto organizzativo intorno alle domande da rispondere, e l'infrastruttura dei dati esistente e imminente.

Sie arbeiten in der Creator-Organisation zusammen und formatieren Teams (z. B. Shorts, Live), um ein ganzheitliches Verständnis des Creator-Ökosystems und der Monetarisierung aufzubauen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Data-Science-Peers zusammen, um über Standardmetriken hinauszugehen, indem Sie quantitative Untersuchungen zum Nutzer- und Schöpferverhalten durchführen, um strukturelle Möglichkeiten für das Ökosystem der Channel-Mitgliedschaften aufzudecken und Startempfehlungen durch fortschrittliches experimentelles Design und kausale Inferenzanalyse zu unterstützen.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in Python, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.

• 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

• 1 year of experience with Research and Artificial Intelligence.

Preferred qualifications:

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience with software development in C++.

• Experience with system design, distributed computing, machine learning.

• Experience with Research publications.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Cloud AI Research - Co-Scientist is a research team with the mission to accelerate scientific discovery with AI. In this role, you will develop a system for scientific discovery which entails literature research, data analysis, hypothesis generation and validation. The ultimate goal is to build a system that assists scientists from diverse fields with their hardest problems. You will use Google’s latest AI tools and models and have the opportunity to collaborate with scientists in Google and from universities and partner labs.
 The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

Responsibilities

• Develop projects and components end-to-end on the Cloud software stack.

• Build, and deploy agentic AI systems, robust tool-use mechanisms, and multi-agent workflows.

• Analyze datasets, make data driven decisions, develop quality criteria and scoring rubics for AI systems.

• Collaborate with scientists and researchers across Google DeepMind, Google Research, and prestigious external academic partners to publish original research.
