Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Cloud AI Research - Co-Scientist è un team di ricerca con la missione di accelerare la scoperta scientifica con AI. In questo ruolo, svilupperai un sistema per la scoperta scientifica che comporta la ricerca della letteratura, l'analisi dei dati, la generazione di ipotesi e la validazione. L'obiettivo finale è quello di costruire un sistema che aiuta gli scienziati da campi diversi con i loro problemi più difficili. Userai gli ultimi strumenti e modelli AI di Google e avrai l'opportunità di collaborare con gli scienziati di Google e da università e laboratori partner.
Il team di Google Cloud AI Research affronta le sfide di AI motivate dalla missione di Google Cloud di portare AI in tecnologia, salute, finanza, vendita al dettaglio e molti altri settori. Lavoriamo su una serie di problemi unici focalizzati su argomenti di ricerca che massimizzano l'impatto scientifico e reale, mirando a spingere lo stato dell'arte in AI e condividere i risultati con la più ampia comunità di ricerca. Collaboriamo anche con i team di prodotti per portare innovazioni a impatto reale che beneficiano i nostri clienti.

responsabilità

• Sviluppa progetti e componenti end-to-end sullo stack software Cloud.

• Costruire e distribuire sistemi AI agentici, robusti meccanismi di utilizzo degli strumenti e flussi di lavoro multi-agenti.

• Analizzare i dataset, prendere decisioni basate sui dati, sviluppare criteri di qualità e punteggio rubics per i sistemi AI.

• Collabora con scienziati e ricercatori di Google DeepMind, Google Research e prestigiosi partner accademici esterni per pubblicare ricerche originali.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in Python, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.

• 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

• 1 year of experience with Research and Artificial Intelligence.

Preferred qualifications:

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience with software development in C++.

• Experience with system design, distributed computing, machine learning.

• Experience with Research publications.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Cloud AI Research - Co-Scientist is a research team with the mission to accelerate scientific discovery with AI. In this role, you will develop a system for scientific discovery which entails literature research, data analysis, hypothesis generation and validation. The ultimate goal is to build a system that assists scientists from diverse fields with their hardest problems. You will use Google’s latest AI tools and models and have the opportunity to collaborate with scientists in Google and from universities and partner labs.
The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

Responsibilities

• Develop projects and components end-to-end on the Cloud software stack.

• Build, and deploy agentic AI systems, robust tool-use mechanisms, and multi-agent workflows.

• Analyze datasets, make data driven decisions, develop quality criteria and scoring rubics for AI systems.

• Collaborate with scientists and researchers across Google DeepMind, Google Research, and prestigious external academic partners to publish original research.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience as a sales engineer or technical consultant in a cloud computing environment or in a customer-facing role.

• 2 years of experience managing a software engineering, FDE, or a similar technical customer-facing team in a cloud computing environment.

• Experience in Python or a similar coding language.

• Experience developing AI/GenAI solutions utilizing AI tools, or designing multi-agent workflows or RAG systems.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Experience designing end-to-end secure, observable multi-agent systems using complex design patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection), state management, and tool-calling protocols.

• Experience designing intuitive interfaces for complex AI and agentic systems, prioritizing context engineering, transparency, and explainability to foster user trust.

• Experience architecting AI solutions within complex infrastructures, ensuring data sovereignty and secure governance.

• Experience performing discovery interviews to identify business problems and translate complex hardware/AI constraints for C-suites and technical teams.

About the job
As a Manager of a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team, you will lead engineers who bridge the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. You will be responsible for a team that doesn't just consult, but codes, debugs and jointly deploys bespoke agentic solutions directly within customer environments. In this role, you will provide deep-dive technical mentorship to your team while balancing high-level alignment with Product, Engineering, and Google Cloud Regional Sales leadership. You will empower and unblock your team as they resolve production-level obstacles, including data readiness issues, integration complexities, and state-management issues that hinder AI from achieving enterprise-grade maturity.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
 Responsibilities

• Serve as the technical lead, establishing code standards, architectural best practices, and benchmarks to elevate engineering excellence across the team.

• Partner with Sales and Tech Leadership to define requirements for high-value opportunities, deploying specialized experts (MLOps, GenMedia, or Agentic systems) to key accounts.

• Lead technical hiring for FDE, evaluating AI/ML expertise, systems engineering, and coding skills to build an exceptional engineering team.

• Identify skill gaps in emerging tech ( model context protocol (MCP), tool-calling, and foundation models), ensuring the team maintains subject matter expertise in an evolving AI stack.

• Collaborate with Product and Engineering to resolve blockers and translate field insights into roadmaps while building internal tools to drive organizational efficiency.

• 2 anni di esperienza nella gestione di un'ingegneria software, FDE, o di un team tecnico simile in un ambiente cloud computing.

• Esperienza in Python o una lingua di codifica simile.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI/GenAI che utilizzano strumenti AI, o nella progettazione di flussi di lavoro multi-agenti o sistemi RAG.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Master o PhD in AI, Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.

• Esperienza nella progettazione di sistemi multi-agenti sicuri e osservabili end-to-end utilizzando modelli di progettazione complessi (ad esempio, ReAct, auto-riflessione), gestione dello stato e protocolli di monitoraggio degli strumenti.

• Esperienza nella progettazione di interfacce intuitive per complessi sistemi AI e agentic, priorità di ingegneria del contesto, trasparenza e spiegabilità per favorire la fiducia degli utenti.

• Scopri le soluzioni AI all'interno di infrastrutture complesse, garantendo la sovranità dei dati e la governance sicura.

• Sperimenta le interviste alla scoperta per identificare i problemi aziendali e tradurre vincoli hardware/AI complessi per C-suites e team tecnici.

Riguardo al lavoro
Come manager di un team di GenAI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), guiderai gli ingegneri che colmano il divario tra i prodotti AI di frontiera e la realtà di produzione all'interno dei clienti. Sarete responsabili di un team che non si limita a consultare, ma codici, debug e distribuisce congiuntamente soluzioni di bespoke agentic direttamente all'interno degli ambienti dei clienti. In questo ruolo, fornirai una guida tecnica approfondita al tuo team, bilanciando al contempo l'allineamento di alto livello con Product, Engineering e Google Cloud Regional Sales. Potrai potenziare e sbloccare il tuo team in quanto risolvono gli ostacoli di livello di produzione, inclusi i problemi di disponibilità dei dati, complessitÃ di integrazione e problemi di gestione dello stato che ostacolano l'IA dal raggiungimento della maturità di livello enterprise. E 'un momento emozionante per unire il team Go-To-Market di Google Cloud, leader la rivoluzione AI per le imprese in tutto il mondo. Potrai eccellere sfruttando la credibilità del marchio di Google, un'eredità costruita sull'invenzione delle tecnologie di base e provata in scala. Vi forniremo il portafoglio AI più avanzato al mondo, compresi i modelli di frontiera Gemini, e la piattaforma completa Vertex AI, aiutandovi a risolvere i problemi aziendali. Siamo una cultura collaborativa che offre accesso diretto alle menti ingegneristiche e di ricerca di DeepMind, consentendoti di risolvere le sfide dei clienti. Unisciti a noi per essere il catalizzatore per la nostra missione, guidare il successo del cliente e definire la nuova era cloud - il mercato è tuo.
responsabilità

• Servire come lead tecnico, stabilire standard di codice, best practice architettoniche e benchmark per elevare l'eccellenza ingegneristica in tutto il team.

• Partner con Sales e Tech Leadership per definire i requisiti per le opportunità di alto valore, implementando esperti specializzati (MLOps, GenMedia, o sistemi Agentic) per i conti chiave.

• Condurre l'assunzione tecnica per FDE, valutare le competenze AI/ML, l'ingegneria dei sistemi e le competenze di codifica per costruire un team di ingegneria eccezionale.

• Identificare le lacune di abilità nella tecnologia emergente (protocollo contestuale modello (MCP), modelli di creazione di strumenti, e modelli di fondazione), assicurando che il team mantiene competenze di materia soggetto in uno stack AI in evoluzione.

• Collabora con Prodotto e Ingegneria per risolvere i bloccanti e tradurre intuizioni sul campo in roadmap, costruendo strumenti interni per guidare l'efficienza organizzativa.

• Führen Sie die technische Einstellung für FDE, die Bewertung von AI / ML-Know-how, Systems Engineering und Codierung Fähigkeiten, um ein außergewöhnliches Engineering-Team aufzubauen.

• Identifizieren Sie Qualifikationslücken in aufstrebenden Technologien (Modellkontextprotokoll (MCP), Tool-Calling und Foundation-Modelle), um sicherzustellen, dass das Team Fachkenntnisse in einem sich entwickelnden KI-Stack beibehält.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Product and Engineering zusammen, um Blocker aufzulösen und Field Insights in Roadmaps zu übersetzen, während Sie interne Tools entwickeln, um die organisatorische Effizienz zu steigern.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat en génie, informatique, un domaine connexe, ou une expérience pratique équivalente.

• 8 ans d'expérience en tant qu'ingénieur commercial ou consultant technique dans un environnement cloud computing ou dans un rôle orienté vers le client.

• 2 ans d'expérience en gestion d'une ingénierie logicielle, FDE, ou une équipe technique similaire orientée vers le client dans un environnement cloud computing.

• Expérience en Python ou dans un langage de codage similaire.

• Expérimentez le développement de solutions AI/GenAI à l'aide d'outils AI ou la conception de workflows multi-agents ou de systèmes RAG.

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en intelligence artificielle, informatique ou domaine technique connexe.

• Expérience de la conception de systèmes multiagents sécurisés et observables de bout en bout en utilisant des modèles de conception complexes (p. ex., ReAct, autoréflexion), la gestion de l'état et des protocoles d'appel d'outils.

• Expérience de conception d'interfaces intuitives pour des systèmes complexes d'IA et d'agents, hiérarchisant l'ingénierie contextuelle, la transparence et l'explicabilité pour favoriser la confiance des utilisateurs.

• Expérimentez l'architecture de solutions d'IA dans des infrastructures complexes, assurant la souveraineté des données et la sécurité de la gouvernance.

• Expérience en matière d'entrevues de découverte pour cerner les problèmes d'affaires et traduire les contraintes complexes du matériel et de l'AI pour les C-suites et les équipes techniques.

Sur le travail
En tant que gestionnaire d'une équipe GenAI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), vous dirigerez des ingénieurs qui combleront l'écart entre les produits d'IA frontaliers et la réalité de production au sein des clients. Vous serez responsable d'une équipe qui ne se contente pas de consulter, mais de coder, de déboguer et de déployer conjointement des solutions agentiques sur mesure directement dans les environnements clients. Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez un mentorat technique profond à votre équipe tout en conciliant l'alignement de haut niveau avec le leadership des ventes régionales Product, Engineering et Google Cloud. Vous autonomiserez et débloquerez votre équipe en résolvant les obstacles à la production, y compris les problèmes de préparation aux données, les complexités d'intégration et les problèmes de gestion d'État qui empêchent l'IA d'atteindre la maturité de l'entreprise. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre l'équipe Go-To-Market de Google Cloud, en dirigeant la révolution de l'IA pour les entreprises du monde entier. Vous excellerez en tirant parti de la crédibilité de la marque de Google – un héritage construit sur l'invention de technologies fondamentales et prouvé à l'échelle. Nous vous fournissons le portefeuille AI le plus avancé au monde, y compris les modèles frontière Gemini, et la plateforme Altex AI complète, vous aidant à résoudre des problèmes d'affaires. Nous sommes une culture collaborative offrant un accès direct aux esprits d'ingénierie et de recherche de DeepMind, vous permettant de résoudre les défis des clients. Rejoignez-nous pour être le catalyseur de notre mission, stimuler le succès client et définir la nouvelle ère du cloud – le marché est à vous.
Responsabilités

• Servir de chef de file technique, établir des normes de code, des pratiques exemplaires en architecture et des points de repère pour élever l'excellence en génie dans toute l'équipe.

• Partenaire avec Sales and Tech Leadership pour définir les exigences pour des opportunités de grande valeur, en déployant des experts spécialisés (MLOps, GenMedia ou systèmes Agentic) sur des comptes clés.

• Diriger l'embauche technique pour le FDE, évaluer l'expertise AI/ML, l'ingénierie des systèmes et les compétences en codage pour constituer une équipe d'ingénierie exceptionnelle.

• Recenser les lacunes en matière de compétences dans les nouvelles technologies (protocole de contexte de modèle, appel d'outils et modèles de base), en veillant à ce que l'équipe conserve l'expertise en matière dans une pile d'IA en évolution.

• Collaborer avec Produits et Ingénierie pour résoudre les obstacles et traduire les connaissances sur le terrain en feuilles de route tout en construisant des outils internes pour stimuler l'efficacité organisationnelle.

titleByLocale.it: Software Ingegnere II, Geo
titleByLocale.en: Software Engineer II, Geo
titleByLocale.de: Software Ingenieur II, Geo
titleByLocale.fr: Software Ingénieur II, Geo

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

• 1 year of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with C++ or Java.

• Experience with one of: quality work, applications of GenAI at Google, or working on large serving systems or pipelines.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Responsibilities

• Own projects end-to-end from idea to design, implementation, and launch.

• Contribute to our big bets, for example by bringing AI/ML to our pipelines, improving our location infrastructure and data for GenAI clients like Ask Maps and Gemini, or building our next-generation Streaming IPGeo infrastructure.

• Protect the reliability of our serving systems and pipelines.

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 1 anno di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio, Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).

• 1 anno di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• Esperienza di integrare gli strumenti generativi AI o le interfacce LLM in flussi di lavoro.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Esperienza con C++ o Java.

• Esperienza con uno di: lavoro di qualità, applicazioni di GenAI a Google, o lavorare su grandi sistemi di servizio o tubazioni.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia. Il team Geo si concentra sulla costruzione delle mappe più accurate, complete e utili per i nostri utenti, attraverso prodotti come Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, e altro ancora. Ogni mese, più di un miliardo di persone si affidano ai servizi Maps per esplorare il mondo e navigare nella loro vita quotidiana.

Il team Geo consente anche agli sviluppatori di utilizzare la potenza delle piattaforme Google Maps per migliorare le loro applicazioni e siti web. Mentre tracciano un corso per il futuro della mappatura, stanno risolvendo problemi di informatica complessi, progettando esperienze di prodotto belle e intuitive, e migliorare la nostra comprensione del mondo reale.

responsabilità

• Progetti propri end-to-end dall'idea alla progettazione, implementazione e lancio.

• Contribuisci alle nostre grandi scommesse, ad esempio portando AI/ML alle nostre pipeline, migliorando la nostra infrastruttura di localizzazione e i dati per i clienti GenAI come Ask Maps e Gemini, o costruendo la nostra infrastruttura Streaming IPGeo di nuova generazione.

• Proteggi l'affidabilità dei nostri sistemi di servizio e delle nostre tubazioni.

jobs.title: Data Center Technician II, Third Party Data Centers

titleByLocale.it: Data Center Technician II, Third Party Data Centers
titleByLocale.en: Data Center Technician II, Third Party Data Centers
titleByLocale.de: Data Center Techniker II, Third Party Data Centers
titleByLocale.fr: Data Center Technicien II, Third Party Data Centers

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, and computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.

• Experience with performing component-level repairs on IT equipment.

• Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

• Must have the ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with server hardware, maintenance/repair and troubleshooting/diagnosing.

• Knowledge of networking, including basic topology and protocol understanding.

• Ability to communicate in English fluently, to support client relationship management in this region.

• Excellent Linux skills, including installation, systems administration and troubleshooting.

About the job
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
 The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
 We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

• Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions.

• Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose straightforward issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and apply the resources needed to resolve identified issues.

• Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.

• Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting.

• Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions and limited guidance.

• Must have the ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with server hardware, maintenance/repair and troubleshooting/diagnosing.

• Knowledge of networking, including basic topology and protocol understanding.

• Ability to communicate in English fluently, to support client relationship management in this region.

• Excellent Linux skills, including installation, systems administration and troubleshooting.

About the job
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

• Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions.

• Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose straightforward issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and apply the resources needed to resolve identified issues.

• Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.

• Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting.

• Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions and limited guidance.

titleByLocale.it: Software Ingegnere III, Data Engineering Console, Agentic Infrastructure
titleByLocale.en: Software Engineer III, Data Engineering Console, Agentic Infrastructure
titleByLocale.de: Software Ingenieur III, Data Engineering Console, Agentic Infrastructure

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree in an industry setting.

• 2 years of experience with developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture.

• Experience in system design.

• Experience in C++.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Experience in agentic skills.

• Experience in tools development.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Data Engineering Console provides a single surface for monitoring "data in motion" at Google. It enables monitoring and debugging for pipeline and storage systems across Core, Deepmind, YouTube, Ads, and Technical Infrastructure (TI), with a migration of Flume User Interface to Data Engineering Console taking place in 2026-H1. We will be adapting our systems for an extended purpose: as a Data Engineering Context provider for agentic systems, a governance dashboard for agentic changes to data processing systems, and an immersive experience that provides dependable, deterministic insights for the validation of agentic actions.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
 Responsibilities

• Work independently under the guidance of senior Data Engineering Console engineers. Help us accelerate the workflows of Google employees as they create, deploy and debug business-critical systems for Gemini model training, YouTube, Ads, Search and Artificial Intelligence (AI) research.

• Ensure peta-scale data processing systems and the agents that operate on them are observable by engineers and researchers, while extending our extensive telemetry-gathering connectors to be accessible and scalable in an agent-first world.

• Help to pivot the Data Engineering Console to an agent-first world, while supporting Google employees as they manage peta-scale data flows for everything from Gemini model training to Ads business tracking and YouTube video analysis, with a healthy dose of Waymo self-driving built-in.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo del software o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato in un ambiente industriale.

• 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo di infrastrutture su larga scala, sistemi o reti distribuiti, o esperienza con tecnologie di calcolo, storage o architettura hardware.

• Esperienza nella progettazione del sistema.

• Esperienza in C++.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o in un campo tecnico correlato.

• 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

• Esperienza nelle competenze agentiche.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo degli strumenti.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Il Data Engineering Console fornisce una singola superficie per il monitoraggio "dati in movimento" su Google. Consente il monitoraggio e il debug per sistemi di pipeline e storage attraverso Core, Deepmind, YouTube, Ads e Technical Infrastructure (TI), con una migrazione di Flume User Interface to Data Engineering Console che si svolge nel 2026-H1. Saremo adattando i nostri sistemi a uno scopo esteso: come fornitore di Data Engineering Context per sistemi agentic, una dashboard di governance per modifiche agentiche ai sistemi di elaborazione dati, e un'esperienza immersiva che fornisce intuizioni affidabili e deterministiche per la validazione delle azioni agentiche. Il team Core costruisce il fondamento tecnico dietro i prodotti di punta di Google. Siamo proprietari e sostenitori per gli elementi di design sottostanti, piattaforme di sviluppatori, componenti di prodotto e infrastrutture a Google. Questi sono i mattoni essenziali per esperienze eccellenti, sicure e coerenti per i nostri utenti e guidare il ritmo di innovazione per ogni sviluppatore. Guardiamo attraverso i prodotti di Google per costruire soluzioni centrali, abbattere le barriere tecniche e rafforzare i sistemi esistenti. Come team Core, abbiamo un mandato e un'opportunità unica per influenzare importanti decisioni tecniche in tutta l'azienda.
responsabilità

• Lavorare indipendentemente sotto la guida degli ingegneri senior Data Engineering Console. Aiutaci ad accelerare i flussi di lavoro dei dipendenti di Google in quanto creano, dispiegano e debug sistemi business-critical per la formazione dei modelli Gemini, YouTube, Ads, Search and Artificial Intelligence (AI).

• Assicurare sistemi di elaborazione dati su scala peta e gli agenti che operano su di essi sono osservabili da ingegneri e ricercatori, estendendo i nostri ampi connettori di telemetria per essere accessibili e scalabili in un primo mondo agente.

• Aiuta a ruotare la console di ingegneria dei dati in un mondo agente-primo, mentre supporta i dipendenti di Google mentre gestiscono flussi di dati su scala peta per tutto, dalla formazione del modello Gemini al monitoraggio aziendale Ads e all'analisi video di YouTube, con una dose sana di auto-driving Waymo integrato.

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung oder 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem fortgeschrittenen Abschluss in einer Industrieumgebung.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung großer Infrastrukturen, verteilter Systeme oder Netzwerke oder Erfahrung mit Rechentechnologien, Speicher- oder Hardwarearchitektur.

• Erfahrung im Systemdesign.

• Erfahrung in C++.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung zugänglicher Technologien.

• Erfahrung in agentischen Fähigkeiten.

• Erfahrung in der Werkzeugentwicklung.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Die Data Engineering Console bietet eine einzige Oberfläche für die Überwachung von "Data in Motion" bei Google. Es ermöglicht die Überwachung und das Debuggen von Pipeline- und Speichersystemen in Core, Deepmind, YouTube, Ads und Technical Infrastructure (TI), wobei eine Migration von Flume User Interface zur Data Engineering Console in 2026-H1 stattfindet. Wir werden unsere Systeme für einen erweiterten Zweck anpassen: als Data Engineering Context Provider für agentische Systeme, als Governance-Dashboard für agentische Änderungen an Datenverarbeitungssystemen und als immersives Erlebnis, das zuverlässige, deterministische Einblicke für die Validierung agentischer Aktionen bietet. Das Core-Team bildet die technische Grundlage für die Flaggschiffprodukte von Google. Wir sind Eigentümer und Befürworter der zugrunde liegenden Designelemente, Entwicklerplattformen, Produktkomponenten und Infrastruktur bei Google. Dies sind die wesentlichen Bausteine für hervorragende, sichere und kohärente Erlebnisse für unsere Benutzer und treiben das Innovationstempo für jeden Entwickler voran. Wir schauen uns die Produkte von Google an, um zentrale Lösungen zu entwickeln, technische Barrieren abzubauen und bestehende Systeme zu stärken. Als Kernteam haben wir ein Mandat und eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, wichtige technische Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen zu beeinflussen.
Zuständigkeiten

• Arbeiten Sie unabhängig unter der Leitung von leitenden Data Engineering Console-Ingenieuren. Helfen Sie uns, die Arbeitsabläufe von Google-Mitarbeitern zu beschleunigen, wenn sie geschäftskritische Systeme für Gemini-Modelltraining, YouTube, Anzeigen, Suche und künstliche Intelligenz (KI) erstellen, bereitstellen und debuggen.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Datenverarbeitungssysteme im Peta-Maßstab und die darauf arbeitenden Agenten von Ingenieuren und Forschern beobachtbar sind, während Sie unsere umfangreichen Telemetrie-Verbindungen erweitern, um in einer Agent-First-Welt zugänglich und skalierbar zu sein.

• Helfen Sie dabei, die Data Engineering Console in eine Agent-First-Welt zu bringen, und unterstützen Sie Google-Mitarbeiter bei der Verwaltung von Datenflüssen im Peta-Maßstab für alles, von Gemini-Modellschulungen bis hin zu Ads-Business-Tracking und YouTube-Videoanalyse, mit einer gesunden Dosis Waymo-Selbstfahrer.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 2 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé dans un contexte industriel.

• 2 ans d'expérience dans le développement d'infrastructures à grande échelle, de systèmes ou de réseaux distribués, ou d'expérience dans les technologies de calcul, le stockage ou l'architecture matérielle.

• Expérience dans la conception du système.

• Expérience en C++.

Titres préférés:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe.

• 2 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.

• Expérience du développement de technologies accessibles.

• Expérience en techniques d'agent.

• Expérience dans le développement d'outils.

Sur le travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

La console d'ingénierie des données fournit une surface unique pour la surveillance des "données en mouvement" chez Google. Il permet la surveillance et le débogage des systèmes de pipeline et de stockage à travers Core, Deepmind, YouTube, Ads et Technical Infrastructure (TI), avec une migration de Flume User Interface vers Data Engineering Console qui a lieu en 2026-H1. Nous adapterons nos systèmes dans un but étendu : en tant que fournisseur de contexte de l'ingénierie des données pour les systèmes d'agents, un tableau de bord de gouvernance pour les changements d'agents aux systèmes de traitement des données, et une expérience immersive qui fournit des informations fiables et déterministes pour la validation des actions d'agents. L'équipe de base construit la base technique derrière Google produits phares. Nous sommes propriétaires et défenseurs des éléments de conception sous-jacents, des plateformes de développement, des composants de produits et de l'infrastructure chez Google. Ce sont les éléments essentiels pour des expériences excellentes, sûres et cohérentes pour nos utilisateurs et stimuler le rythme de l'innovation pour chaque développeur. Nous regardons les produits Google pour construire des solutions centrales, briser les barrières techniques et renforcer les systèmes existants. En tant qu'équipe principale, nous avons un mandat et une occasion unique d'influer sur les décisions techniques importantes de l'entreprise.
Responsabilités

• Travaillez indépendamment sous la direction d'ingénieurs de Data Engineering Console. Aidez-nous à accélérer les flux de travail des employés de Google au fur et à mesure qu'ils créent, déploient et déboguent des systèmes critiques pour la formation de modèles Gemini, YouTube, annonces, recherche et intelligence artificielle (AI).

• Veiller à ce que les systèmes de traitement des données à l'échelle des pétas et les agents qui les utilisent soient observables par les ingénieurs et les chercheurs, tout en élargissant nos nombreux connecteurs de collecte de télémétrie pour qu'ils soient accessibles et évolutifs dans un premier monde d'agents.

• Aide à pivoter la console Data Engineering vers un monde agent-premier, tout en soutenant les employés de Google comme ils gèrent les flux de données à l'échelle de péta pour tout, de la formation modèle Gemini à Ads business tracking et l'analyse vidéo YouTube, avec une bonne dose de Waymo auto-conduit intégré.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience in a technical security role (e.g., security engineering, security research, DevSecOps, or incident response).

• Experience with vulnerability assessments and vulnerability exploitation.

• Experience in security and ethical hacking.

Preferred qualifications:

• 3 years of offensive security experience (red teaming, vulnerability research, pen testing, etc - not just running tools) in Cloud environment.

• Experience with Artificial Intelligence.

• Ability to develop custom exploits, modify existing exploits, and bypass security controls.

• Fluency in programming languages relevant to security and cloud automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).

• Being able to clearly and concisely articulate complex technical findings, risks, and remediation strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.

About the job
Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As a part of the Product Security Engineering team within the Cloud CISO organization, you will be responsible for helping ensure every product in Cloud is as secure as it can be, and increasing the security in the infrastructure underlying all our products.

As a part of the Cloud Red Team, your mission is to evaluate our ability to detect and respond to known and unknown threats by simulating real-world adversaries that aim to compromise and persist in Cloud’s infrastructure. In short: Hack Cloud to make hacking Cloud harder.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Define and maintain the roadmap for one of the programs within Cloud Red Team, while collaborating within a highly-skilled team to plan and execute attacks against Cloud’s products, services, and infrastructure.

• Build tools and infrastructure to support attacker goals, while identifying vulnerabilities and attack vectors across Cloud services, configurations, and related technologies.

• Participate in threat modeling exercises to identify potential attack paths and weaknesses in Cloud architectures and deployments.

• Design realistic and relevant attack scenarios based on current threat intelligence and the specific Cloud environment being assessed.

• Create reports that capture the insights gained during an attack and present them to a variety of audiences.

descriptionByLocale.it:

• 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di sicurezza tecnica (ad esempio, ingegneria della sicurezza, ricerca sulla sicurezza, DevSecOps, o risposta agli incidenti).

• Esperienza con le valutazioni della vulnerabilità e lo sfruttamento della vulnerabilità.

• Esperienza nella sicurezza e hacking etico.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• 3 anni di esperienza di sicurezza offensiva (red teaming, ricerca di vulnerabilità, test di penna, ecc - non solo strumenti di esecuzione) in ambiente Cloud.

• Esperienza con intelligenza artificiale.

• Capacità di sviluppare exploit personalizzati, modificare gli exploit esistenti e bypassare i controlli di sicurezza.

• Fluency in linguaggi di programmazione rilevanti per la sicurezza e l'automazione cloud (ad esempio, Python, Go, Bash).

• Essere in grado di articolare chiaramente e concisamente complesse scoperte tecniche, rischi e strategie di bonifica a pubblico tecnico e non tecnico, sia verbalmente che per iscritto.

Riguardo al lavoro
Il nostro team di sicurezza lavora per creare e mantenere l'ambiente operativo più sicuro per gli utenti e gli sviluppatori di Google. Gli ingegneri di sicurezza lavorano con apparecchiature di rete e monitorano attivamente i nostri sistemi per attacchi e intrusioni. In questo ruolo, lavorerai anche con gli ingegneri del software per identificare proattivamente e correggere i difetti di sicurezza e le vulnerabilità.

Come parte del team Product Security Engineering all'interno dell'organizzazione Cloud CISO, sarete responsabili di aiutare a garantire che ogni prodotto in Cloud sia sicuro come può essere, e aumentare la sicurezza nell'infrastruttura sottostante tutti i nostri prodotti.

Come parte del Cloud Red Team, la vostra missione è quella di valutare la nostra capacità di rilevare e rispondere a minacce conosciute e sconosciute simulando gli avversari del mondo reale che mirano a compromettere e persistere nell’infrastruttura di Cloud. In breve: Hack Cloud per rendere più difficile hacking Cloud.
La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% target bonus + equity + benefici

Scopri di più sui vantaggi di Google .
responsabilità

• Definire e mantenere la roadmap per uno dei programmi all'interno del Cloud Red Team, collaborando all'interno di un team altamente qualificato per pianificare ed eseguire attacchi contro i prodotti, i servizi e le infrastrutture di Cloud.

• Costruire strumenti e infrastrutture per supportare gli obiettivi degli attaccanti, identificando le vulnerabilità e i vettori di attacco attraverso i servizi Cloud, le configurazioni e le tecnologie correlate.

• Partecipare a esercizi di modellazione delle minacce per identificare potenziali percorsi di attacco e debolezze nelle architetture e nelle implementazioni Cloud.

• Progettare scenari di attacco realistici e rilevanti basati sull'attuale intelligenza delle minacce e sull'ambiente cloud specifico in fase di valutazione.

• Crea report che catturano le intuizioni acquisite durante un attacco e li presentano a una varietà di pubblico.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience with software development in C++ and Python or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience with machine learning tools and algorithms, specifically deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and deep learning models.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 1 year of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.

• Knowledge of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and Generative AI.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.
 Responsibilities

• Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.

• Perform model training, evaluation, and deployment to solve business-critical problems.This includes exploration of new model architectures, augmenting existing training data, finding better evaluation methods and feedback signals, and identifying headroom opportunities.

• Understand production systems, visualize, monitor, and optimize performance.

• Stay up-to-date with latest tools and research in the field working actively with our collaborators.

Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

In questo ruolo, con le tue competenze tecniche gestirai priorità di progetto, scadenze e consegnabili. Potrai progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni software. Google Ads sta aiutando ad alimentare Internet aperto con la migliore tecnologia che collega e crea valore per le persone, editori, inserzionisti, e Google. Siamo costituiti da più team, la costruzione di prodotti pubblicitari di Google, tra cui ricerca, display, shopping, viaggi e pubblicità video, nonché analisi. I nostri team creano esperienze fidate tra persone e aziende con annunci utili. Aiutiamo a crescere le aziende di tutte le dimensioni da piccole imprese, a grandi marchi, ai creatori di YouTube, con efficaci strumenti di inserzionista che forniscono risultati misurabili. Permettiamo anche a Google di interagire con i clienti in scala.
responsabilità

• Progetti propri end-to-end dall'idea iniziale alla progettazione, all'analisi e all'implementazione.

• Eseguire la formazione, la valutazione e la distribuzione del modello per risolvere i problemi business-critical. Questo include l'esplorazione di nuove architetture di modelli, l'aumento dei dati di formazione esistenti, la ricerca di metodi di valutazione migliori e segnali di feedback, e l'individuazione delle opportunità di headroom.

• Comprendere i sistemi di produzione, visualizzare, monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni.

• Resta aggiornato con gli ultimi strumenti e la ricerca sul campo lavorando attivamente con i nostri collaboratori.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience with software development in C++ and Python or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience with machine learning tools and algorithms, specifically deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and deep learning models.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 1 year of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.

• Knowledge of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and Generative AI.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.
Responsibilities

• Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.

• Perform model training, evaluation, and deployment to solve business-critical problems.This includes exploration of new model architectures, augmenting existing training data, finding better evaluation methods and feedback signals, and identifying headroom opportunities.

• Understand production systems, visualize, monitor, and optimize performance.

• Stay up-to-date with latest tools and research in the field working actively with our collaborators.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience in front-end development, technical UX design, or prototyping.

• Experience building and maintaining functional prototypes or internal tools.

• Experience in modern front-end frameworks (e.g., JavaScript, React, Angular) and styling languages.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or AI-driven application logic.

• Experience building Figma plugins, command line interface (CLI) tools, or scripts that improve team productivity.

• Experience with UX engineering platforms (Web/Mobile).

• Passion for or experience in cybersecurity, privacy frameworks, or risk mitigation.

• Ability to visualize complex security data or system topologies in a way that is simple and performant.

About the job
 At Google, we follow a simple but vital premise: "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Google’s UX Engineers are versatile and passionate about taking on new problems to drive progress and vision for design teams. They’re comfortable wearing many hats and get excited about working across discipline lines to develop products and prototypes that bring new ideas to life.

Google User Experience (UX) is made up of multi-disciplinary teams of UX Designers, Researchers, Writers, Content Strategists, Program Managers, and Engineers: we care deeply about the people who use our products. The UX team plays an integral part in gathering insights about the attitudes, emotions, and behaviors of people who use our products to inspire and inform design. We collaborate closely with each other and with engineering and product management to create industry-leading products that deliver value for the people who use them, and for Google’s businesses.

As a UX Engineer, you'll work as part of a UX team in a challenging, fast-paced environment. You’ll demonstrate your creativity, analytical skills, and knowledge of user facing technologies to create prototypes that identify the best product experiences, launch innovative features, build tools that accelerate UX teams, bridge between design and engineering discussions, and enable efficient, high quality execution.

User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”
 Responsibilities

• Build high-fidelity prototypes simulating agentic AI to test privacy and security concepts in real-world scenarios.

• Translate complex PSS design requirements into technical specs and production-ready front-end code.

• Use AI tools and LLMs to accelerate coding and build responsive UI components for security tooling.

• Evaluate AI/UX patterns to identify technical constraints and rogue agent behaviors early in design.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to build reusable, accessible UI components and iterate on 0-to-1 products.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea in Informatica o un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo front-end, progettazione tecnica UX, o prototipazione.

• Sperimentare la costruzione e mantenere prototipi funzionali o strumenti interni.

• Esperienza nei moderni framework front-end (ad esempio, JavaScript, React, Angular) e linguaggi di styling.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Esperienza di lavoro con API LLM, ingegneria rapida, o logica di applicazione AI-driven.

• Esperienza costruzione plugin Figma, strumenti di interfaccia di riga di comando (CLI), o script che migliorano la produttività del team.

• Esperienza con piattaforme di ingegneria UX (Web/Mobile).

• Passione per o esperienza in sicurezza informatica, strutture privacy, o mitigazione del rischio.

• Capacità di visualizzare dati di sicurezza complessi o topologie di sistema in un modo semplice e performante.

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google, seguiamo una premessa semplice ma vitale: "Focus sull'utente e tutto il resto seguirà". Gli ingegneri UX di Google sono versatili e appassionati di prendere nuovi problemi per guidare il progresso e la visione per i team di progettazione. Sono confortevoli indossando molti cappelli e si eccitano a lavorare attraverso le linee di disciplina per sviluppare prodotti e prototipi che portano alla vita nuove idee.

Google User Experience (UX) è composto da team multidisciplinari di progettisti, ricercatori, scrittori, Strateghi dei contenuti, Program Manager e ingegneri: ci preoccupiamo profondamente delle persone che utilizzano i nostri prodotti. Il team UX svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel raccogliere informazioni sugli atteggiamenti, le emozioni e i comportamenti delle persone che utilizzano i nostri prodotti per ispirare e informare il design. Collaboriamo a stretto contatto con l'altro e con l'ingegneria e la gestione dei prodotti per creare prodotti leader del settore che forniscono valore per le persone che li utilizzano, e per le aziende di Google.

Come ingegnere UX, lavorerai come parte di un team UX in un ambiente difficile e veloce. Potrai dimostrare la tua creatività, abilità analitiche e la conoscenza delle tecnologie di fronte all'utente per creare prototipi che identificano le migliori esperienze di prodotto, lanciare funzionalità innovative, costruire strumenti che accelerano i team UX, ponte tra progettazione e discussioni ingegneristiche, e consentire un'esecuzione efficiente e di alta qualità.

L'esperienza dell'utente è all'avanguardia nel modo in cui creiamo prodotti intuitivi, innovativi e belli che la gente ama. Ci sforziamo di imparare e comprendere le esigenze, i comportamenti e le emozioni dei nostri utenti per raccogliere informazioni che informano la strategia e il design del prodotto. I nostri team UX includono designer, ricercatori, strateghi dei contenuti e ingegneri che sono appassionati di qualità, usabilità e semplicità. Lavoriamo su team collaborativi per risolvere complesse sfide e esperienze artigianali che evidenziano le capacità e le personalità uniche dei nostri prodotti. Il nostro lavoro tocca miliardi esemplifica un principio chiave che è fondamentale per la filosofia di Google: “Focus sull’utente e tutto il resto seguirà”.
responsabilità

• Costruire prototipi ad alta fedeltà simulando agentic AI per testare i concetti di privacy e sicurezza in scenari reali.

• Tradurre complessi requisiti di progettazione PSS in specifiche tecniche e codice front-end di produzione pronto.

• Utilizzare gli strumenti AI e LLM per accelerare la codifica e costruire componenti UI reattivi per gli strumenti di sicurezza.

• Valutare i modelli AI/UX per identificare i vincoli tecnici e i comportamenti degli agenti rogue all'inizio della progettazione.

• Partner con team interfunzionali per costruire componenti UI riutilizzabili e accessibili e iterare su prodotti 0-to-1.

• Expérience de travail avec les API LLM, l'ingénierie rapide, ou la logique d'application axée sur l'IA.

• Découvrez la création de plugins Figma, d'outils d'interface en ligne de commande (CLI) ou de scripts qui améliorent la productivité de l'équipe.

• Expérience des plateformes d'ingénierie UX (Web/Mobile).

• La passion pour la cybersécurité, les cadres de protection de la vie privée ou l'atténuation des risques.

• Capacité de visualiser des données de sécurité complexes ou topologies système d'une manière simple et performante.

Sur le travail
Chez Google, nous suivons une prémisse simple mais vitale: "Focus sur l'utilisateur et tout le reste suivra." Les ingénieurs UX de Google sont polyvalents et passionnés à prendre de nouveaux problèmes pour conduire le progrès et la vision pour les équipes de conception. Ils sont à l'aise de porter de nombreux chapeaux et se réjouissent de travailler à travers les lignes de discipline pour développer des produits et des prototypes qui donnent vie à de nouvelles idées.

Google User Experience (UX) est composé d'équipes multidisciplinaires de designers, chercheurs, écrivains, stratèges de contenu, gestionnaires de programmes et ingénieurs : nous nous intéressons profondément aux personnes qui utilisent nos produits. L'équipe UX joue un rôle essentiel dans la collecte d'informations sur les attitudes, les émotions et les comportements des personnes qui utilisent nos produits pour inspirer et informer le design. Nous collaborons étroitement les uns avec les autres et avec l'ingénierie et la gestion des produits pour créer des produits de pointe qui offrent de la valeur aux personnes qui les utilisent, ainsi qu'aux entreprises de Google.

En tant qu'ingénieur UX, vous travaillerez comme membre d'une équipe UX dans un environnement difficile et rapide. Vous démontrerez votre créativité, vos compétences analytiques et votre connaissance des technologies face à l'utilisateur pour créer des prototypes qui identifient les meilleures expériences de produits, lancent des fonctionnalités innovantes, construisent des outils qui accélèrent les équipes UX, relient les discussions de conception et d'ingénierie et permettent une exécution efficace et de haute qualité.

L'expérience utilisateur est à l'avant-garde de la façon dont nous créons des produits intuitifs, innovants et beaux que les gens aiment. Nous nous efforçons d'apprendre et de comprendre les besoins, les comportements et les émotions de nos utilisateurs pour recueillir des idées qui éclairent la stratégie et la conception des produits. Nos équipes UX comprennent des concepteurs, des chercheurs, des stratèges de contenu et des ingénieurs passionnés par la qualité, la convivialité et la simplicité. Nous travaillons sur des équipes collaboratives pour résoudre des défis complexes et des expériences artisanales qui mettent en valeur nos produits. Notre travail touche des milliards tout en exemplifiant un principe clé qui est au cœur de la philosophie de Google: -Focus sur l'utilisateur et tout le reste suivra.
Responsabilités

• Construisez des prototypes de haute fidélité simulant l'IA agentique pour tester les concepts de confidentialité et de sécurité dans des scénarios réels.

• Traduire les exigences complexes de conception PSS en spécifications techniques et en code front-end prêt à la production.

• Utilisez des outils d'IA et des LLM pour accélérer le codage et construire des composants d'interface utilisateur adaptés pour l'outillage de sécurité.

• Évaluer les profils AI/UX pour identifier les contraintes techniques et les comportements des agents voyous au début de la conception.

• Partenaire avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour construire des composants d'assurance-chômage réutilisables et accessibles et itérer sur des produits de 0 à 1.

jobs.title: Customer Solution Engineer, Google Flights

titleByLocale.it: Customer Solution Ingegnere, Google Flights
titleByLocale.en: Customer Solution Engineer, Google Flights
titleByLocale.de: Customer Solution Ingenieur, Google Flights
titleByLocale.fr: Customer Solution Ingénieur, Google Flights

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience in a technical, client-facing role such as Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, or Technical Project Management.

• Experience in software development in Java.

• Experience with data analysis and querying using SQL.

• Experience with web technologies (e.g., HTTP, APIs, XML, JSON) and troubleshooting technical integrations.

• Experience with a scripting language (e.g., Python, JavaScript) for automation and data analysis.

Preferred qualifications:

• Proven experience scaling operations through process automation, third-party vendor management, or the application of new technologies (e.g., leveraging APIs, Large Language Model (LLMs).

• Excellent project management skills with a proven ability to act as an owner, who can work independently, navigate ambiguity, and drive projects to completion with minimal guidance.

• Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for data and a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.

• A desire to improve the experience for millions of users worldwide.

About the job
In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's various product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).Our Technical Solutions Engineers help manage customer relationships, in addition to providing level-two support to our other Support teams. In this role, you will be a part of a global team that provides support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud. You will troubleshoot any technical challenges for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, documentation updating, and coding/scripting. You will make our products continuously easier to adopt and to use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes, and documentation.
 Responsibilities

• Lead the technical onboarding of global airlines and Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) onto Google Flights, integrating complex partner feeds and dedicating significant engineering effort to the implementation, scaling, and debugging of dynamic pricing structures.

• Act as the primary technical point of contact for airlines, Business Development, and other internal teams, communicating complex technical issues clearly and driving initiatives to improve data quality.

• Own end-to-end data quality frameworks across Google Flights, replacing manual processes by building automated validation pipelines, scalable data ingestion mechanisms, and troubleshooting tools.

• Collaborate directly with Zurich-based Software Engineering and Product Management to test and ship backend improvements, regulatory compliance measures, and dynamic pricing updates.

• Serve as the ultimate escalation point to diagnose root causes of pricing mismatches, feed failures, and integration blockades using deep data analysis (SQL) and log inspection.
